// infra/aws/services.dag -- AWS API service declarations for infra resources.
//
// Raw AWS API operations used by the resource acquire blocks.
// Uses AWS REST/JSON APIs with SigV4 authentication.

module infra.aws.services


// --- S3 ------------------------------------------------------------------

service aws.S3 {

  operation HeadBucket {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool }
  }

  operation CreateBucket {
    input {
      bucket: NonEmptyStr
      region: String = "us-east-1"
      tags: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { location: String }
  }

  operation DeleteBucket {
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  operation GetObject {
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr, key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { body: Bytes, found: Bool }
  }

  operation PutObject {
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr, key: NonEmptyStr, body: Bytes }
    output { etag: String }
  }

  operation DeleteObject {
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr, key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  operation ListObjectsV2 {
    input { bucket: NonEmptyStr, prefix: String? }
    output { keys: List<NonEmptyStr>, truncated: Bool }
  }
}


// --- Lambda --------------------------------------------------------------

service aws.Lambda {

  operation GetFunction {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { function_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, function_arn: String?, state: String? }
  }

  operation CreateFunction {
    input {
      function_name: NonEmptyStr
      runtime: String = "provided.al2023"
      handler: String = "bootstrap"
      role: NonEmptyStr
      code_s3_bucket: NonEmptyStr
      code_s3_key: NonEmptyStr
      memory_size: Int = 512
      timeout: Int = 300
      environment: Map<String, String>?
      tags: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { function_arn: String }
  }

  operation UpdateFunctionCode {
    input {
      function_name: NonEmptyStr
      s3_bucket: NonEmptyStr
      s3_key: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { function_arn: String }
  }

  operation UpdateFunctionConfiguration {
    input {
      function_name: NonEmptyStr
      memory_size: Int?
      timeout: Int?
      environment: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { function_arn: String }
  }

  operation Invoke {
    input { function_name: NonEmptyStr, payload: ArtifactPayload }
    output { status_code: Int, payload: ArtifactPayload }
  }

  operation DeleteFunction {
    input { function_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}


// --- Secrets Manager -----------------------------------------------------

service aws.SecretsManager {

  operation DescribeSecret {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { secret_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, arn: String?, name: String? }
    // AWS Secrets Manager uses POST with X-Amz-Target header
  }

  operation CreateSecret {
    input { name: NonEmptyStr, secret_string: Secret, tags: Map<String, String>? }
    output { arn: String, name: String }
  }

  operation GetSecretValue {
    input { secret_id: NonEmptyStr, version_stage: String = "AWSCURRENT" }
    output { secret_string: Secret, version_id: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  operation PutSecretValue {
    input { secret_id: NonEmptyStr, secret_string: Secret }
    output { version_id: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  operation RotateSecret {
    input { secret_id: NonEmptyStr, rotation_lambda_arn: String? }
    output { arn: String, version_id: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  operation ListSecretVersionIds {
    input { secret_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { versions: List<NonEmptyStr> }
  }
}


// --- IAM -----------------------------------------------------------------

service aws.IAM {

  operation GetRole {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { role_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, arn: String?, role_name: String? }
  }

  operation CreateRole {
    input {
      role_name: NonEmptyStr
      assume_role_policy: Json

      tags: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { arn: String, role_name: String }

  operation AttachRolePolicy {
    input { role_name: NonEmptyStr, policy_arn: NonEmptyStr }

    input { role_name: NonEmptyStr, policy_arn: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}

// --- STS -----------------------------------------------------------------

service aws.STS {

  operation AssumeRole {
    input { role_arn: NonEmptyStr, session_name: NonEmptyStr, duration_seconds: Int = 3600 }
    output { access_key_id: Secret, secret_access_key: Secret, session_token: Secret, expiration: String }
  }

  operation AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity {
    input { role_arn: NonEmptyStr, session_name: NonEmptyStr, web_identity_token: Secret }
    output { access_key_id: Secret, secret_access_key: Secret, session_token: Secret, expiration: String }
  }
}

// --- SQS -----------------------------------------------------------------

service aws.SQS {

  operation GetQueueUrl {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { queue_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, queue_url: Url? }
  }

  operation CreateQueue {
    input {
      queue_name: NonEmptyStr
      visibility_timeout: Int = 30
      message_retention_period: Int = 345600
      tags: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { queue_url: Url }
  }

  operation SendMessage {
    input { queue_url: Url, message_body: String }
    output { message_id: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  operation ReceiveMessage {
    input { queue_url: Url, max_messages: Int = 10, wait_time_seconds: Int = 0 }
    output { messages: List<Json> }

  operation DeleteMessage {
    input { queue_url: Url, receipt_handle: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  operation PurgeQueue {
    input { queue_url: Url }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}

# dsl/infra/azure/resources.dag
```
// infra/azure/resources.dag -- Azure infrastructure as first-class resources.
//
// Each resource implements an abstract interface from infra/core.dag.
// The acquire block contains the Azure-specific ensure/upsert DAG.
// Azure uses ARM-style APIs via management.azure.com.

module infra.azure.resources

import infra.core { ObjectStorage, Compute, SecretStore, Identity, Queue, QueueMessage }
import infra.spec { ResourceFingerprint, ReconcileAction }
import infra.azure.services
import std.types { Timestamp }


// =========================================================================
// Blob Container  --  implements ObjectStorage
// =========================================================================

resource BlobContainer implements ObjectStorage {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    account_name: NonEmptyStr
    name: NonEmptyStr
  }

  acquire {
    check = azure.BlobStorage.GetContainer(
      account_name: config.account_name,
      container: config.name
    )

    create [when !check.exists] = azure.BlobStorage.CreateContainer(
      account_name: config.account_name,
      container: config.name
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability read {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { content: Bytes, found: Bool }
  }

  capability write {
    input { key: NonEmptyStr, content: Bytes }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability delete {
    input { key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability list {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { prefix: String }
    output { keys: List<NonEmptyStr> }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Container App  --  implements Compute
// =========================================================================

resource ContainerApp implements Compute {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    subscription_id: NonEmptyStr
    resource_group: NonEmptyStr
    location: String = "eastus"
    image: NonEmptyStr
    target_port: Int = 8080
    cpu: Float = 0.5
    memory: String = "1Gi"
    min_replicas: Int = 0
    max_replicas: Int = 10
    env: Map<String, String>?
    managed_identity_id: String?
  }

  acquire {
    check = azure.ContainerApps.Get(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      name: config.name
    )

    deploy = azure.ContainerApps.CreateOrUpdate(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      name: config.name,
      location: config.location,
      image: config.image,
      target_port: config.target_port,
      cpu: config.cpu,
      memory: config.memory,
      min_replicas: config.min_replicas,
      max_replicas: config.max_replicas,
      env: config.env,
      managed_identity_id: config.managed_identity_id,
      tags: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_tags()
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability deploy {
    input { image: NonEmptyStr, env: Map<String, String>? }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability invoke {
    input { path: String, body: Json }
    output { response: Json, status: Int }
  }

  capability get_url {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { url: Url }
  }

  capability scale {
    input { min_instances: Int, max_instances: Int }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Key Vault Secret  --  implements SecretStore
// =========================================================================

resource KeyVaultSecret implements SecretStore {
  kind: Capability
  mode: Read
  key: name
  expires: true

  config {
    vault_name: NonEmptyStr
    name: NonEmptyStr
  }

  acquire {
    check = azure.KeyVault.GetSecret(
      vault_name: config.vault_name,
      name: config.name
    )

    // Key Vault secrets are created via SetSecret (idempotent PUT)
    // If the secret doesn't exist yet, we don't create an empty one --
    // we assume it will be populated via write_value or external tooling.

  }

  release {}

  capability read_value {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { value: Secret }
  }

  capability write_value {
    input { value: Secret }
    output { ok: Bool, version: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  capability rotate {
    input { new_value: Secret }
    output { ok: Bool, new_version: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  capability list_versions {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { versions: List<NonEmptyStr> }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Managed Identity  --  implements Identity
// =========================================================================

resource AzureManagedIdentity implements Identity {
  kind: Capability
  mode: Read
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    subscription_id: NonEmptyStr
    resource_group: NonEmptyStr
    location: String = "eastus"
  }

  acquire {
    check = azure.ManagedIdentity.Get(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      name: config.name
    )

    create [when !check.exists] = azure.ManagedIdentity.Create(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      name: config.name,
      location: config.location,
      tags: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_tags()
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability assume {
    readonly
    input { scopes: List<String>, lifetime_seconds: Int = 3600 }
    output { token: Secret, expires_at: Timestamp }
    // Azure: Acquire token via MSAL / managed identity endpoint
  }

  capability grant {
    input { role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
    // Azure: CreateRoleAssignment
  }

  capability revoke {
    input { role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
    // Azure: DeleteRoleAssignment
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Service Bus Queue  --  implements Queue<String>
// =========================================================================

resource ServiceBusQueue implements Queue<String> {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    subscription_id: NonEmptyStr
    resource_group: NonEmptyStr
    namespace: NonEmptyStr
    lock_duration: String = "PT30S"
    max_delivery_count: Int = 5
  }

  acquire {
    check = azure.ServiceBus.GetQueue(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      namespace: config.namespace,
      queue_name: config.name
    )

    create [when !check.exists] = azure.ServiceBus.CreateQueue(
      subscription_id: config.subscription_id,
      resource_group: config.resource_group,
      namespace: config.namespace,
      queue_name: config.name,
      lock_duration: config.lock_duration,
      max_delivery_count: config.max_delivery_count
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability publish {
    input { message: String }
    output { message_id: NonEmptyStr, ok: Bool }
  }

  capability subscribe {
    readonly
    input {}
    output { messages: List<QueueMessage<String>> }
  }

  capability ack {
    input { message_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability purge {
    input {}
    output { purged_count: Int }
  }
}

# dsl/infra/core.dag
```
// infra/core.dag -- Abstract infrastructure interfaces.
//
// These define WHAT infrastructure capabilities exist, not HOW they're
// provided. Each cloud provider (GCP, AWS, Azure) implements these
// interfaces with provider-specific resource declarations.
//
// Business logic writes `uses store: ObjectStorage(...)` and the
// provider is selected at compile time via environment config.
//
// SET-THEORETIC GROUNDING:
// Each interface defines a set of types that implement it (Level 8):
//   ⟦ObjectStorage⟧ = {T ∈ Type | T has read, write, delete, list}
// Provider resources implement via subset inclusion:
//   GcsBucket ∈ ⟦ObjectStorage⟧, S3Bucket ∈ ⟦ObjectStorage⟧, etc.
//
// DAG GROUNDING:
// Each interface's capabilities are Dag<TypeOp> for input/output validation.
// The @contract annotations generate behavioral tests for any implementor.
//
// See dsl-design.md §4.1 Level 8 and §7.6 for the full model.

module infra.core

import std.types { Timestamp }

// =========================================================================
// ObjectStorage -- Key-value object store
// =========================================================================
//
// Implementations: GcsBucket (GCP), S3Bucket (AWS), BlobContainer (Azure)
//
// The canonical cloud-agnostic storage interface. Any backend that can
// store and retrieve blobs by key satisfies this contract.

interface ObjectStorage {
  capability read(key: NonEmptyStr) -> { content: Bytes, found: Bool }
    readonly
    idempotent

  capability write(key: NonEmptyStr, content: Bytes) -> { ok: Bool }

  capability delete(key: NonEmptyStr) -> { ok: Bool }

  capability list(prefix: String) -> { keys: List<NonEmptyStr> }
    readonly
    idempotent

  // Behavioral contracts -- compiler generates verification tests for
  // every implementor (GCS, S3, Azure Blob).
  contract read_after_write_returns_value
  contract delete_removes_key
}


// =========================================================================
// Compute -- Deployable compute unit
// =========================================================================
//
// Implementations: CloudRunService (GCP), LambdaFunction (AWS), ContainerApp (Azure)
//
// Represents a deployable unit of computation with an HTTP endpoint.
// The acquire block handles deployment; capabilities handle invocation.

interface Compute {
  capability deploy(image: NonEmptyStr, env: Map<String, String>?) -> { ok: Bool }

  capability invoke(path: String, body: Json) -> { response: Json, status: Int }

  capability get_url() -> { url: Url }
    readonly
    idempotent

  capability scale(min_instances: Int, max_instances: Int) -> { ok: Bool }

  // Contracts
}


// =========================================================================
// SecretStore -- Managed secret storage
// =========================================================================
//
// Implementations: ManagedSecret (GCP), AwsSecret (AWS), KeyVaultSecret (Azure)
//
// Secrets with lifecycle management: creation, versioning, rotation,
// and access control. The `expires` property on the resource signals
// that handles are time-bounded.

interface SecretStore {
  capability read_value() -> { value: Secret }
    readonly
    idempotent

  capability write_value(value: Secret) -> { ok: Bool, version: NonEmptyStr }

  capability rotate(new_value: Secret) -> { ok: Bool, new_version: NonEmptyStr }

  capability list_versions() -> { versions: List<NonEmptyStr> }
    readonly
    idempotent

  // Contracts
}


// =========================================================================
// Identity -- Cloud identity / service account
// =========================================================================
//
// Implementations: GcpServiceAccount (GCP), AwsIamRole (AWS), ManagedIdentity (Azure)
//
// Represents a workload identity that can be assumed to gain permissions.
// The acquire block creates/ensures the identity exists; capabilities
// handle token generation and permission grants.

interface Identity {
  capability assume(scopes: List<String>, lifetime_seconds: Int = 3600)
    -> { token: Secret, expires_at: Timestamp }

  capability grant(role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr) -> { ok: Bool }

  capability revoke(role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr) -> { ok: Bool }

  // Contracts
}


// =========================================================================
// Queue -- Message queue / pub-sub
// =========================================================================
//
// Implementations: PubSubTopic (GCP), SqsQueue (AWS), ServiceBusQueue (Azure)
//
// Asynchronous message passing with at-least-once delivery guarantee.
// Generic over the message type T (must be Serializable).

interface Queue<T> {
  capability publish(message: T) -> { message_id: NonEmptyStr, ok: Bool }

  capability subscribe() -> { messages: List<QueueMessage<T>> }
    readonly

  capability ack(message_id: NonEmptyStr) -> { ok: Bool }

  capability purge() -> { purged_count: Int }

  // Contracts
}

// Message wrapper for queue items
type QueueMessage<T> {
  id: NonEmptyStr
  body: T
  received_at: Timestamp
  delivery_count: Int
}


// =========================================================================
// Provider-neutral types
// =========================================================================

// Cloud provider discriminator
type CloudProvider = Gcp | Aws | Azure

// Provider-specific cloud account configuration (sum type)
type CloudConfig
  = GcpConfig {
      project_id: ProjectId
      project_number: NonEmptyStr
      region: String = "us-central1"
      zone: String = "us-central1-a"
    }
  | AwsConfig {
      account_id: NonEmptyStr
      region: String = "us-east-1"
      profile: String?
    }
  | AzureConfig {
      subscription_id: NonEmptyStr
      resource_group: NonEmptyStr
      location: String = "eastus"
      tenant_id: NonEmptyStr
    }

// --- Environments --------------------------------------------------------

type Environment = Dev | Ci | Test | Prod

// Unified environment config (provider-neutral outer shell)
type InfraEnvironment {
  name: Environment
  cloud: CloudConfig
  secrets_prefix: String = ""
  tags: Map<String, String> = {}
}

// Helper to extract the provider from a config
fn provider_of(config: CloudConfig) -> CloudProvider {
  match config {
    GcpConfig { ... }   => Gcp
    AwsConfig { ... }   => Aws
    AzureConfig { ... } => Azure
  }
}
```

# dsl/infra/gcp/resources.dag
```
// infra/gcp/resources.dag -- GCP infrastructure as first-class resources.
//
// Each resource implements an abstract interface from infra/core.dag.
// The acquire block contains the GCP-specific ensure/upsert DAG.
// Business logic `uses` these via the abstract interface or directly.
//
// Compiler behavior:
//   1. Inserts acquire nodes (ensure/upsert DAG) at DAG boundaries
//   2. Threads resource handles to consuming nodes
//   3. Detects conflicts (e.g., two funcs writing same bucket)
//   4. Generates integration tests from @mock_response annotations
//   5. Manages release/cleanup lifecycle
//   6. Verifies @contract compliance from the abstract interface

module infra.gcp.resources

import infra.core { ObjectStorage, Compute, SecretStore, Identity, Queue, QueueMessage }
import infra.spec { ResourceFingerprint, ReconcileAction }
import infra.gcp.services
import std.types { Timestamp }


// =========================================================================
// GCS Bucket  --  implements ObjectStorage
// =========================================================================

resource GcsBucket implements ObjectStorage {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    location: String = "us-central1"
    storage_class: String = "STANDARD"
    project_id: ProjectId
  }

  acquire {
    check = gcp.Storage.GetBucket(name: config.name)
    create [when !check.exists] = gcp.Storage.CreateBucket(
      project_id: config.project,
      name: config.name,
      location: config.location,
      storage_class: config.storage_class,
      labels: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_labels()
    )
    resolve = gcp.Storage.GetBucket(name: config.name) [after create]

  }

  release {}

  // Capabilities map to ObjectStorage interface
  capability read {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { content: Bytes, found: Bool }
  }

  capability write {
    input { key: NonEmptyStr, content: Bytes }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability delete {
    input { key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability list {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { prefix: String }
    output { keys: List<NonEmptyStr> }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Cloud Run Service  --  implements Compute
// =========================================================================

resource CloudRunService implements Compute {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: ProjectId
    region: String = "us-central1"
    image: NonEmptyStr
    memory: String = "512Mi"
    cpu: Int = 1
    min_instances: Int = 0
    max_instances: Int = 10
    env: Map<String, String>?
    service_account: ServiceAccountEmail?
  }

  acquire {
    check = gcp.CloudRun.GetService(
      project_id: config.project,
      region: config.region,
      name: config.name
    )

    create [when !check.exists] = gcp.CloudRun.CreateService(
      project_id: config.project,
      region: config.region,
      name: config.name,
      image: config.image,
      memory: config.memory,
      cpu: config.cpu,
      min_instances: config.min_instances,
      max_instances: config.max_instances,
      env: config.env,
      service_account: config.service_account,
      labels: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_labels()
    )

    update [when check.exists && check.labels.spec_hash != hash(config)] = gcp.CloudRun.UpdateService(
      project_id: config.project,
      region: config.region,
      name: config.name,
      image: config.image,
      memory: config.memory,
      env: config.env,
      labels: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_labels()
    )

    resolve = gcp.CloudRun.GetService(
      project_id: config.project,
      region: config.region,
      name: config.name
    ) [after create, after update]

  }

  release {}

  capability deploy {
    input { image: NonEmptyStr, env: Map<String, String>? }
    output { ok: Bool }
    // Triggers an update of the running service
  }

  capability invoke {
    input { path: String, body: Json }
    output { response: Json, status: Int }
  }

  capability get_url {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { url: Url }
  }

  capability scale {
    input { min_instances: Int, max_instances: Int }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Managed Secret  --  implements SecretStore
// =========================================================================

resource ManagedSecret implements SecretStore {
  kind: Capability
  mode: Read
  key: secret_id
  expires: true

  config {
    project_id: ProjectId
    secret_id: NonEmptyStr
    prefix: String = ""
  }

  acquire {
    full_name = "{config.prefix}{config.secret_id}"

    check = gcp.SecretManager.Lifecycle.GetSecret(
      project_id: config.project,
      secret: full_name
    )

    create [when !check.exists] = gcp.SecretManager.Lifecycle.CreateSecret(
      project_id: config.project,
      secret_id: full_name
    )

    resolve = gcp.SecretManager.Lifecycle.GetSecret(
      project_id: config.project,
      secret: full_name
    ) [after create]

  }

  release {}

  capability read_value {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { value: Secret }
  }

  capability write_value {
    input { value: Secret }
    output { ok: Bool, version: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  capability rotate {
    input { new_value: Secret }
    output { ok: Bool, new_version: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  capability list_versions {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input {}
    output { versions: List<NonEmptyStr> }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Service Account  --  implements Identity
// =========================================================================

resource GcpServiceAccount implements Identity {
  kind: Capability
  mode: Read
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: ProjectId
    display_name: String
    roles: List<String>
  }

  acquire {
    email = "{config.name}@{config.project}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"

    check = gcp.IAM.Lifecycle.GetServiceAccount(project_id: config.project, email: email)

    create [when !check.exists] = gcp.IAM.Lifecycle.CreateServiceAccount(
      project_id: config.project,
      account_id: config.name,
      display_name: config.display_name
    )

    roles = for role in config.roles {
      gcp.ResourceManager.Infra.SetIamBinding(
        project_id: config.project,
        role: role,
        member: "serviceAccount:{email}"
      )
    } [after create]

  }

  release {}

  capability assume {
    readonly
    input { scopes: List<String>, lifetime_seconds: Int = 3600 }
    output { token: Secret, expires_at: Timestamp }
  }

  capability grant {
    input { role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability revoke {
    input { role: NonEmptyStr, target: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Workload Identity Federation  (GCP-specific, no abstract interface)
// =========================================================================
// WIF is GCP-specific -- AWS uses OIDC federation differently, Azure uses
// federated credentials on managed identities. No common interface.

resource WifProvider {
  kind: Capability
  mode: Read
  key: pool_id

  config {
    project_number: NonEmptyStr
    pool_id: NonEmptyStr
    provider_id: NonEmptyStr
    issuer_uri: Url
    attribute_mapping: Map<String, String>
    attribute_condition: String?
  }

  acquire {
    check_pool = gcp.WIF.GetPool(
      project_id: config.project_number,
      pool_id: config.pool_id
    )

    create_pool [when !check_pool.exists] = gcp.WIF.CreatePool(
      project_id: config.project_number,
      pool_id: config.pool_id,
      display_name: config.pool_id
    )

    check_provider = gcp.WIF.GetProvider(
      project_id: config.project_number,
      pool_id: config.pool_id,
      provider_id: config.provider_id
    ) [after create_pool]

    create_provider [when !check_provider.exists] = gcp.WIF.CreateProvider(
      project_id: config.project_number,
      pool_id: config.pool_id,
      provider_id: config.provider_id,
      issuer_uri: config.issuer_uri,
      attribute_mapping: config.attribute_mapping,
      attribute_condition: config.attribute_condition
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability get_token {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { audience: NonEmptyStr }
    output { token: Secret }
  }
}


// =========================================================================
// Pub/Sub Topic  --  implements Queue<Bytes>
// =========================================================================

resource PubSubTopic implements Queue<Bytes> {
  kind: Capability
  mode: ReadWrite
  key: name

  config {
    name: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: ProjectId
  }

  acquire {
    check = gcp.PubSub.GetTopic(project_id: config.project, topic: config.name)

    create [when !check.exists] = gcp.PubSub.CreateTopic(
      project_id: config.project,
      topic: config.name,
      labels: ResourceFingerprint { spec_hash: hash(config) }.to_labels()
    )

  }

  release {}

  capability publish {
    input { message: Bytes }
    output { message_id: NonEmptyStr, ok: Bool }
  }

  capability subscribe {
    readonly
    input {}
    output { messages: List<QueueMessage<Bytes>> }
  }

  capability ack {
    input { message_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  capability purge {
    input {}
    output { purged_count: Int }
  }
}
```

# dsl/infra/gcp/services.dag
```
// infra/gcp/services.dag -- GCP API service declarations for infra resources.
//
// These are the raw GCP API operations used by the resource acquire blocks.
// Separate from the higher-level services in dsl/services/gcp/ which cover
// application-level APIs (Secret Manager access, IAM token generation).
//
// These focus on resource lifecycle: create, get, update, delete.

module infra.gcp.services

// --- Cloud Storage -------------------------------------------------------

service gcp.Storage {

  operation GetBucket {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String, labels: Map<String, String>? }
  }

  operation CreateBucket {
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      name: NonEmptyStr
      location: String = "us-central1"
      storage_class: String = "STANDARD"
      labels: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { name: String, selfLink: Url }
  }

  operation DeleteBucket {
    input { name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}

// --- Cloud Run -----------------------------------------------------------

service gcp.CloudRun {

  operation GetService {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, region: String, name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String, uri: Url?, labels: Map<String, String>? }
  }

  operation CreateService {
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      region: String
      name: NonEmptyStr
      image: NonEmptyStr
      memory: String = "512Mi"
      cpu: Int = 1
      min_instances: Int = 0
      max_instances: Int = 10
      env: Map<String, String>?
      service_account: ServiceAccountEmail?
      labels: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { name: String, uri: Url }
  }

  operation UpdateService {
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      region: String
      name: NonEmptyStr
      image: NonEmptyStr
      memory: String
      env: Map<String, String>?
      labels: Map<String, String>?
    }
    output { name: String, uri: Url }
  }

  operation DeleteService {
    input { project_id: ProjectId, region: String, name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }

  // SP-2: Revision management for traffic migration.
  operation ListRevisions {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, region: String, service_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { revisions: List<Json> }
  }

  operation GetRevision {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, region: String, service_name: NonEmptyStr, revision_name: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String, image: String?, ready: Bool }
  }

  // SP-2: Traffic migration (gradual rollout).
  operation UpdateTraffic {
    idempotent
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      region: String
      service_name: NonEmptyStr
      traffic: List<Json>    // [{revision: "rev-name", percent: 100}]
    }
    output { ok: Bool, uri: Url }
  }

  // SP-2: Wait for revision readiness (poll-based).
  operation WaitReady {
    readonly
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      region: String
      service_name: NonEmptyStr
      revision_name: NonEmptyStr
      timeout_seconds: Int = 300
    }
    output { ready: Bool, reason: String? }
  }
}

// --- Secret Manager (lifecycle) ------------------------------------------

service gcp.SecretManager.Lifecycle {

  operation GetSecret {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, secret: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String }
  }

  operation CreateSecret {
    input { project_id: ProjectId, secret_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { name: String }
  }

  operation AddVersion {
    input { secret_name: NonEmptyStr, payload: Bytes }
    output { name: String }
  }

  operation DeleteSecret {
    input { project_id: ProjectId, secret: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}

// --- IAM (lifecycle) -----------------------------------------------------

service gcp.IAM.Lifecycle {

  operation GetServiceAccount {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, email: ServiceAccountEmail }
    output { exists: Bool, email: String }
  }

  operation CreateServiceAccount {
    input {
      project_id: ProjectId
      account_id: NonEmptyStr
      display_name: String
    }
    output { email: ServiceAccountEmail }
  }
}

// --- Workload Identity Federation ----------------------------------------

service gcp.WIF {

  operation GetPool {
    input { project_id: NonEmptyStr, pool_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String }
  }

  operation CreatePool {
    input { project_id: NonEmptyStr, pool_id: NonEmptyStr, display_name: String }
    output { name: String }
  }

  operation GetProvider {
    input { project_id: NonEmptyStr, pool_id: NonEmptyStr, provider_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String }
  }

  operation CreateProvider {
    input {
      project_id: NonEmptyStr
      pool_id: NonEmptyStr
      provider_id: NonEmptyStr
      issuer_uri: Url
      attribute_mapping: Map<String, String>
      attribute_condition: String?
    }
    output { name: String }
  }
}

// --- Pub/Sub -------------------------------------------------------------

service gcp.PubSub {

  operation GetTopic {
    readonly
    idempotent
    input { project_id: ProjectId, topic: NonEmptyStr }
    output { exists: Bool, name: String }
  }

  operation CreateTopic {
    input { project_id: ProjectId, topic: NonEmptyStr, labels: Map<String, String>? }
    output { name: String }
  }

  operation Publish {
    input { topic: NonEmptyStr, payload: Bytes, attributes: Map<String, String>? }
    output { message_id: NonEmptyStr }
  }

  operation Pull {
    input { subscription: NonEmptyStr, max_messages: Int = 10 }
    output { messages: List<Json> }
  }

  operation Ack {
    input { subscription: NonEmptyStr, ack_ids: List<NonEmptyStr> }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}

// --- Resource Manager (IAM bindings) -------------------------------------

service gcp.ResourceManager.Infra {

  operation SetIamBinding {
    input { project_id: ProjectId, role: NonEmptyStr, member: NonEmptyStr }
    output { ok: Bool }
  }
}
```

# dsl/infra/sdlc/deploy.dag
```
// infra/sdlc/deploy.dag -- SDLC pipeline deployment spec.
//
// Declares the infrastructure resources needed for the SDLC worker:
//   - GCS bucket for ledger storage
//   - Cloud Run service for the worker
//   - Secret Manager secrets for GitHub token
//   - Service account with appropriate roles
//
// Uses the existing infra/gcp/services.dag operations and
// infra/gcp/config.dag environment configs.

module infra.sdlc.deploy

import infra.gcp.services { Storage, CloudRun, SecretManager, IAM }
import infra.gcp.config { gcp_dev_config }

fn worker_service_name() -> String {
  "gunbc-sdlc-worker"
}

fn ledger_bucket_name(project_id: String) -> String {
  "{project_id}-sdlc-ledger"
}

fn worker_image(project_id: String, region: String) -> String {
  "{region}-docker.pkg.dev/{project_id}/gunbc/sdlc-worker:latest"
}

fn worker_sa_email(project_id: String) -> String {
  "gunbc-sdlc-worker@{project_id}.iam.gserviceaccount.com"
}

// ── Resource declarations ───────────────────────────────────────────

func deploy_ledger_bucket(project_id: String) -> { name: String } {
  existing = Storage.GetBucket(name: ledger_bucket_name(project_id: project_id))

  if !existing.exists {
    created = Storage.CreateBucket(
      project_id: project_id,
      name: ledger_bucket_name(project_id: project_id),
      location: "us-central1",
      storage_class: "STANDARD",
      labels: { "managed-by": "gunbc", "component": "sdlc-ledger" }
    )
    return { name: created.name }
  }

  return { name: existing.name }
}

func deploy_service_account(project_id: String) -> { email: String } {
  existing = IAM.GetServiceAccount(
    project_id: project_id,
    email: worker_sa_email(project_id: project_id)
  )

  if !existing.exists {
    created = IAM.CreateServiceAccount(
      project_id: project_id,
      account_id: "gunbc-sdlc-worker",
      display_name: "gunbc SDLC Worker"
    )
    return { email: created.email }
  }

  return { email: existing.email }
}

func deploy_worker_service(
  project_id: String,
  region: String
) -> { name: String, uri: String } {
  existing = CloudRun.GetService(
    project_id: project_id,
    region: region,
    name: worker_service_name()
  )

  if !existing.exists {
    created = CloudRun.CreateService(
      project_id: project_id,
      region: region,
      name: worker_service_name(),
      image: worker_image(project_id: project_id, region: region),
      memory: "512Mi",
      cpu: 1,
      min_instances: 0,
      max_instances: 1,
      env: {
        "SDLC_LEDGER_DIR": "/data/ledger",
        "SDLC_REPO_OWNER": "gunb-ai",
        "SDLC_REPO_NAME": "gunbc"
      },
      service_account: worker_sa_email(project_id: project_id),
      labels: { "managed-by": "gunbc", "component": "sdlc-worker" }
    )
    return { name: created.name, uri: created.uri }
  }

  updated = CloudRun.UpdateService(
    project_id: project_id,
    region: region,
    name: worker_service_name(),
    image: worker_image(project_id: project_id, region: region),
    memory: "512Mi",
    env: {
      "SDLC_LEDGER_DIR": "/data/ledger",
      "SDLC_REPO_OWNER": "gunb-ai",
      "SDLC_REPO_NAME": "gunbc"
    },
    labels: { "managed-by": "gunbc", "component": "sdlc-worker" }
  )
  return { name: updated.name, uri: updated.uri }
}

func deploy_github_secret(project_id: String) -> { name: String } {
  existing = SecretManager.GetSecret(
    project_id: project_id,
    secret: "github-token"
  )

  if !existing.exists {
    created = SecretManager.CreateSecret(
      project_id: project_id,
      secret_id: "github-token"
    )
    return { name: created.name }
  }

  return { name: existing.name }
}

// ── SP-2: Revision deployment with traffic migration ──────────────

// Deploy a new revision and wait for readiness before migrating traffic.
// This is the idempotent deploy pattern: if the image hasn't changed,
// the update is a no-op (spec_hash fingerprint in labels).
func deploy_revision(
  project_id: String,
  region: String,
  image: String
) -> { revision: String, uri: String, migrated: Bool } {
  // Deploy new revision via update (creates a new revision if image differs)
  updated = CloudRun.UpdateService(
    project_id: project_id,
    region: region,
    name: worker_service_name(),
    image: image,
    memory: "512Mi",
    env: {
      "SDLC_LEDGER_DIR": "/data/ledger",
      "SDLC_REPO_OWNER": "gunb-ai",
      "SDLC_REPO_NAME": "gunbc"
    },
    labels: { "managed-by": "gunbc", "component": "sdlc-worker", "deploy-image": image }
  )

  // Wait for the new revision to become ready
  ready = CloudRun.WaitReady(
    project_id: project_id,
    region: region,
    service_name: worker_service_name(),
    revision_name: updated.name,
    timeout_seconds: 300
  )

  // Migrate 100% traffic to the new revision once ready
  traffic = if ready.ready {
    CloudRun.UpdateTraffic(
      project_id: project_id,
      region: region,
      service_name: worker_service_name(),
      traffic: [{ revision: updated.name, percent: 100 }]
    )
  }

  return {
    revision: updated.name,
    uri: updated.uri,
    migrated: ready.ready
  }
}

// ── Full deployment pipeline ────────────────────────────────────────

func deploy_all(
  project_id: String,
  region: String
) -> { success: Bool } {
  bucket = deploy_ledger_bucket(project_id: project_id)
  sa = deploy_service_account(project_id: project_id)
  secret = deploy_github_secret(project_id: project_id)
  service = deploy_worker_service(project_id: project_id, region: region)

  return { success: true }
}

// SP-2: Full deployment with revision rollout.
func deploy_with_revision(
  project_id: String,
  region: String,
  image: String
) -> { success: Bool, revision: String, uri: String } {
  // Ensure all infrastructure exists first
  infra = deploy_all(project_id: project_id, region: region)

  // Then deploy the new revision with traffic migration
  rev = deploy_revision(
    project_id: project_id,
    region: region,
    image: image
  )

  return {
    success: rev.migrated,
    revision: rev.revision,
    uri: rev.uri
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test deploy_worker_creates_new_service {

    input deploy_worker_service.project_id -> "test-project"
    input deploy_worker_service.region -> "us-central1"

    // Service does not exist
    mock get_service/execute.response -> rest_response(200, { exists: false })

    // Create succeeds
    mock create_service/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      name: "gunbc-sdlc-worker",
      uri: "https://gunbc-sdlc-worker-abc123.run.app"
    })

    expect result.name == "gunbc-sdlc-worker"
    expect result.uri is NonEmpty
}

test deploy_revision_migrates_traffic {

    input deploy_revision.project_id -> "test-project"
    input deploy_revision.region -> "us-central1"
    input deploy_revision.image -> "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/test-project/gunbc/sdlc-worker:v2"

    // Update creates new revision
    mock update_service/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      name: "gunbc-sdlc-worker-rev2",
      uri: "https://gunbc-sdlc-worker-abc123.run.app"
    })

    // Revision becomes ready
    mock wait_ready/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      ready: true,
      reason: null
    })

    // Traffic migration succeeds
    mock update_traffic/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      ok: true,
      uri: "https://gunbc-sdlc-worker-abc123.run.app"
    })

    expect result.migrated == true
    expect result.revision == "gunbc-sdlc-worker-rev2"
}

test deploy_revision_waits_for_readiness {

    input deploy_revision.project_id -> "test-project"
    input deploy_revision.region -> "us-central1"
    input deploy_revision.image -> "us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/test-project/gunbc/sdlc-worker:v3"

    mock update_service/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      name: "gunbc-sdlc-worker-rev3",
      uri: "https://gunbc-sdlc-worker-abc123.run.app"
    })

    // Revision not ready (timeout)
    mock wait_ready/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      ready: false,
      reason: "Container failed to start"
    })

    // Traffic migration should NOT happen
    expect result.migrated == false
}

# dsl/infra/spec.dag
```
// infra/spec.dag -- Provider-neutral infrastructure spec types.
//
// Typed, compile-time descriptions of desired infrastructure state.
// These are pure data -- no I/O, no side effects. Provider-specific
// specs live in their respective provider directories (gcp/, aws/, azure/).
//
// The ensure/acquire logic lives in the resource declarations.
// Specs are the INPUT to those resources.

module infra.spec

import infra.core { CloudProvider, CloudConfig, InfraEnvironment, Environment }

// --- Reconciliation (provider-neutral) -----------------------------------
// All providers use the same check -> create/update -> resolve pattern.
// These types capture the result of reconciliation regardless of provider.

type ReconcileAction
  = Created
  | Updated { changed_fields: List<String> }
  | Unchanged
  | Deleted
  | Skipped { reason: String }

type ReconcileResult {
  provider: CloudProvider
  resource_kind: NonEmptyStr
  resource_name: NonEmptyStr
  action: ReconcileAction
}

// --- Fingerprinting (drift detection, provider-neutral) ------------------
// All providers use labels/tags to track managed state.
// GCP: labels, AWS: tags, Azure: tags. Same concept, different API names.

type ResourceFingerprint {
  managed_by: String = "gunbc"
  spec_hash: NonEmptyStr
}

// --- Secret lifecycle (provider-neutral) ---------------------------------
// Secrets have the same lifecycle concepts regardless of provider.

type SecretRequirement = Required | Optional
type SecretStatus = Active | Deleted
type RotationHandler = Manual | GitHubPat | ServiceAccountKey | NoRotation

type SecretSpec {
  name: NonEmptyStr
  requirement: SecretRequirement
  status: SecretStatus
  rotation: RotationHandler
  max_age_days: Int?
  scopes: List<String>
  description: String
}

// --- Compute spec (provider-neutral) -------------------------------------
// Common compute configuration that maps to Cloud Run, Lambda, Container Apps.

type ComputeSpec {
  name: NonEmptyStr
  image: NonEmptyStr
  memory: String = "512Mi"
  cpu: Int = 1
  min_instances: Int = 0
  max_instances: Int = 10
  env: Map<String, String>?
  timeout_seconds: Int = 300
}

// --- Storage spec (provider-neutral) -------------------------------------

type StorageSpec {
  name: NonEmptyStr
  versioning: Bool = false
}

// --- Identity spec (provider-neutral) ------------------------------------

type IdentitySpec {
  name: NonEmptyStr
  display_name: String
  description: String
  roles: List<String>
}

// --- Queue spec (provider-neutral) ---------------------------------------

type QueueSpec {
  name: NonEmptyStr
  visibility_timeout_seconds: Int = 30
  message_retention_seconds: Int = 345600    // 4 days
  dead_letter_after: Int = 5                 // max receives before DLQ
}

// --- Aggregate spec (provider-neutral) -----------------------------------
// Describes the full desired state for an environment.

type InfraSpec {
  environment: InfraEnvironment
  identities: List<IdentitySpec>
  secrets: List<SecretSpec>
  storage: List<StorageSpec>
  compute: List<ComputeSpec>
  queues: List<QueueSpec>
}

// --- Cost estimation (provider-neutral) ----------------------------------

type CostTier = XS | S | M | L | XL

fn estimate_cost(spec: InfraSpec) -> CostTier {
  let total_compute = spec.compute |> count()
  let total_storage = spec.storage |> count()
  match total_compute + total_storage {
    n [when n <= 2]  => XS
    n [when n <= 5]  => S
    n [when n <= 10] => M
    n [when n <= 20] => L
    _                => XL
  }
}
```

// interfaces/agent_provider.dag -- Abstract agent execution interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for agent dispatch and lifecycle management.
// The pipeline spawns agents for implementation work and polls their status.
//
// Implementations:
//   CodexAgentProvider  (@shell codex)  — local, cloud_run profiles
//   StubAgentProvider   (in-memory)     — unit_test profile
//
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.4

module interfaces.agent_provider

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, AgentStatus, ApprovalMode }
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { DeliveryGuarantee, QueueSemantics, QueueOrdering }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data execution_delivery: DeliveryGuarantee = AtLeastOnce

data execution_queue_semantics: QueueSemantics = {
  ordering: Fifo,
  visibility_timeout_seconds: 900,
  dead_letter: { max_attempts: 5, destination: "agent_provider.dlq" }
}

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "spawn",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesExternal,
      idempotent: false,
      idempotency_keys: null,
      determinism: NonDeterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "AdmissionDenied", condition: "provider_refused_new_run", http_status: 429, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "spawn may return started=false with queued status under capacity pressure", trigger: "saturated_executor", severity: Medium }],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "agent execution backend available", kind: Infrastructure }],
      assumptions: ["run_id is globally unique within provider namespace"],
      unknowns: ["Long-tail startup latency under burst load"]
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "poll",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_id"],
      determinism: NonDeterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "NotFound", condition: "run_id_unknown", http_status: 404, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "run_id was previously issued by spawn", kind: Runtime }],
      assumptions: ["status transitions are monotonic toward terminal states"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "cancel",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesExternal,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_id"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "cancel may race with natural completion", trigger: "late_cancel", severity: Medium }],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "caller has authority to cancel run", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["final_status reflects terminal state after cancellation attempt"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "get_result",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_id"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "NotReady", condition: "run_not_terminal", http_status: 409, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "run has reached terminal status", kind: Runtime }],
      assumptions: ["stdout/stderr capture may be truncated by provider limits"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Compute, level: Write, resource: "agent_provider.exec" },
  { scope: Storage, level: Read, resource: "agent_provider.logs" },
  { scope: Api, level: Write, resource: "agent_provider.control" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "spawn",
    failures: [{ name: "AdmissionDenied", condition: "provider_refused_new_run", http_status: 429, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }]
  },
  {
    capability: "poll",
    failures: [{ name: "NotFound", condition: "run_id_unknown", http_status: 404, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  },
  {
    capability: "get_result",
    failures: [{ name: "NotReady", condition: "run_not_terminal", http_status: 409, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }]
  }
]

interface AgentProvider {

  // Spawn a new agent task. Returns a run_id for tracking.
  capability spawn(
    prompt:           String,
    repo_path:        String,
    branch:           NonEmptyStr,
    model:            String?,
    timeout_seconds:  Int?,
    approval_mode:    ApprovalMode?
  ) -> { run_id: NonEmptyStr, status: AgentStatus, started: Bool }

  // Poll the status of a running agent task.
  capability poll(run_id: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { status: AgentStatus, finished: Bool, exit_code: Int?, error: String? }
    idempotent
    readonly

  // Cancel a running agent task.
  capability cancel(run_id: NonEmptyStr, reason: String?)
    -> { cancelled: Bool, final_status: AgentStatus }

  // Retrieve the result of a completed agent task.
  capability get_result(run_id: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { status: AgentStatus, exit_code: Int?, stdout: String?, stderr: String?, files_changed: List<String> }
    readonly

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------

}

// interfaces/artifact_store.dag -- Abstract artifact store interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for artifact storage with two-phase commit
// support via provisional/canonical markers.
//
// Implementations:
//   InlineArtifactStore    (issue comments / gists)  — local profile (small artifacts)
//   GcsArtifactStore       (GCS objects)             — cloud_run profile
//   InMemoryArtifactStore  (HashMap)                 — unit_test profile
//
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.6

module interfaces.artifact_store

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, ArtifactPayload, ArtifactType, ArtifactMarker }
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { CasMechanism, DeliveryGuarantee }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data cas_mechanism: CasMechanism = GenerationBased
data delivery_guarantee: DeliveryGuarantee = AtLeastOnce

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "store",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["artifact_id", "content_hash"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "same_artifact_id_different_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "artifact storage write access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["content_hash computed over canonical artifact bytes"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "retrieve",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["artifact_id"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "NotFound", condition: "artifact_missing", http_status: 404, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "artifact storage read access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: [],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "store_marker",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["marker.run_key", "marker.artifact_type", "marker.phase", "marker.content_hash"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "MarkerConflict", condition: "same_marker_key_different_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "marker namespace write access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["Canonical markers are immutable once committed"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "get_canonical_marker",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_key", "artifact_type"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "marker namespace read access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["Canonical marker is authoritative commit pointer"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Storage, level: Write, resource: "artifact_store.payload" },
  { scope: Storage, level: Write, resource: "artifact_store.markers" },
  { scope: Storage, level: Read, resource: "artifact_store.read" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "store",
    failures: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "same_artifact_id_different_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  },
  {
    capability: "store_marker",
    failures: [{ name: "MarkerConflict", condition: "same_marker_key_different_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  }
]

interface ArtifactStore {

  // Store an artifact. Idempotent: same artifact_id + same content_hash = success.
  // Different content_hash for same artifact_id = conflict (fail-closed).
  // Returns stored xor conflict (exactly one is true).
  capability store(
    artifact_id:  NonEmptyStr,
    payload:      ArtifactPayload,
    content_hash: NonEmptyStr
  ) -> { stored: Bool, conflict: Bool }
    idempotent

  // Retrieve an artifact by ID.
  capability retrieve(artifact_id: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { found: Bool, payload: ArtifactPayload?, content_hash: NonEmptyStr? }
    readonly

  // Store an artifact marker (provisional or canonical).
  // Used in the two-phase commit protocol for artifact lifecycle tracking.
  capability store_marker(marker: ArtifactMarker)
    -> { stored: Bool }
    idempotent

  // Get the canonical marker for a given run_key + artifact_type.
  // Only canonical markers represent committed artifacts.
  capability get_canonical_marker(run_key: NonEmptyStr, artifact_type: ArtifactType)
    -> { found: Bool, marker: ArtifactMarker? }
    readonly

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------
  //
  // INV-16: Deterministic artifact for given run_key + artifact_type.
  // INV-17: Canonical markers are authoritative; only they represent committed artifacts.
  // Collision rules: canonical marker with same content_hash = success;
  //                  different content_hash = fail-closed conflict.

}

# dsl/interfaces/claim_store.dag
```
// interfaces/claim_store.dag -- Abstract claim/lease store interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for distributed claim leases. Ensures
// at most one worker processes a given (issue_id, stage) at a time.
//
// Implementations:
//   FileClaimStore      (local JSON files)  — local profile (OS file locking)
//   GcsClaimStore       (GCS objects)       — cloud_run profile (x-goog-if-generation-match)
//   InMemoryClaimStore  (HashMap)           — unit_test profile (version counter)
//
// Addresses: Gap B from e2e-gap-analysis.md
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.2

module interfaces.claim_store

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, IssueLifecycleStage }
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { CasMechanism, LeaseConfig, DeliveryGuarantee }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data cas_mechanism: CasMechanism = GenerationBased

data default_lease: LeaseConfig = {
  ttl_seconds: 300,
  heartbeat_interval_seconds: 60
}

data delivery_guarantee: DeliveryGuarantee = AtMostOnce

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "acquire",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["issue_id", "stage", "owner"],
      determinism: NonDeterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "active_lease_exists", http_status: 409, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "expired leases are reclaimable", trigger: "claim_expired", severity: Medium }],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "coordination storage write access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["generation monotonically increments for each successful acquire"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "heartbeat",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["issue_id", "stage", "owner", "generation"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "LeaseLost", condition: "owner_or_generation_mismatch", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "caller holds active lease", kind: Runtime }],
      assumptions: ["heartbeat extends lease expiry only for current owner+generation"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "release",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["issue_id", "stage", "owner", "generation"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "caller holds active lease", kind: Runtime }],
      assumptions: ["release clears claim ownership for subsequent acquirers"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Storage, level: Write, resource: "claim_store.records" },
  { scope: Queue, level: Write, resource: "claim_store.leases" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "acquire",
    failures: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "active_lease_exists", http_status: 409, recoverable: true, retry_safe: true }]
  },
  {
    capability: "heartbeat",
    failures: [{ name: "LeaseLost", condition: "owner_or_generation_mismatch", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  }
]

interface ClaimStore {

  // Acquire a claim lease for a (issue_id, stage) pair.
  // Returns acquired xor conflict (exactly one is true).
  // If an expired lease exists, it is reclaimable (treated as unclaimed).
  capability acquire(
    issue_id:     NonEmptyStr,
    stage:        NonEmptyStr,
    owner:        NonEmptyStr,
    lease_ttl_ms: Int
  ) -> { acquired: Bool, conflict: Bool, lease_generation: Int }
    idempotent

  // Extend the expiry of an active lease.
  // Requires owner and generation to match the active lease.
  capability heartbeat(
    issue_id:     NonEmptyStr,
    stage:        NonEmptyStr,
    owner:        NonEmptyStr,
    generation:   Int
  ) -> { accepted: Bool }
    idempotent

  // Release an active lease.
  // Requires owner and generation to match the active lease.
  capability release(
    issue_id:     NonEmptyStr,
    stage:        NonEmptyStr,
    owner:        NonEmptyStr,
    generation:   Int
  ) -> { released: Bool }

  // List all active (non-expired) claims. Used by anti-entropy
  // reconciler (SR-7) to detect stale claims with no heartbeat.
  capability list_active() -> {
    claims: List<{
      issue_id: String,
      stage: String,
      owner: String,
      generation: Int,
      acquired_at_epoch_ms: Int,
      last_heartbeat_epoch_ms: Int,
      expires_at_epoch_ms: Int
    }>
  }
    readonly

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------
  //
  // INV-9:  Mutual exclusion — at most one active (non-expired) lease per (issue_id, stage).
  // INV-10: Generation monotonicity — each acquire increments the generation counter.
  // INV-11: Owner verification — heartbeat and release must match owner + generation.
  // INV-24: acquired xor conflict on acquire.

}
```

// interfaces/credential_provider.dag -- Abstract credential acquisition interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for credential acquisition. Tools and
// pipelines import this interface -- never concrete implementations.
//
// Design Decision D-2: provider dispatch is eliminated. The profile
// binds a concrete implementation (GCP WIF, AWS STS, stub) at compile
// time. The DSL author writes `uses cred: CredentialProvider` and
// never sees provider-specific logic.
//
// Implementations:
//   GcpWifCredentialProvider   — local, cloud_run profiles
//   StubCredentialProvider     — unit_test profile
//
// Ported from the-gunbai capability-based auth model.

module interfaces.credential_provider

import std.types {
    AccessToken, AuthScheme, CredentialFlow, NonEmptyStr, Secret
}
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { DeliveryGuarantee }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data token_delivery_guarantee: DeliveryGuarantee = AtLeastOnce

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "acquire",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["secret_name", "flow", "scheme", "source_id", "required_scopes_hash"],
      determinism: NonDeterministic,
      failure_modes: [
        { name: "MissingCredential", condition: "secret_or_source_missing", http_status: 404, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false },
        { name: "InsufficientScope", condition: "token_missing_required_scope", http_status: 403, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }
      ],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "token TTL may be shorter than downstream workflow runtime", trigger: "short_lived_token", severity: High }],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [
        { description: "access to configured credential source", kind: Capability },
        { description: "provider-specific auth handshake configured", kind: Infrastructure }
      ],
      assumptions: ["acquire returns a usable token for selected auth scheme"],
      unknowns: ["Cross-provider clock skew tolerance for exp/nbf checks"]
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "validate",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["token_hash"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "Expired", condition: "token_expired", http_status: 401, recoverable: true, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "provider introspection endpoint reachable when needed", kind: Infrastructure }],
      assumptions: ["validate can return expires_in when provider exposes TTL"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Secret, level: Read, resource: "credential_provider.sources" },
  { scope: Identity, level: Read, resource: "credential_provider.identity" },
  { scope: Federation, level: Read, resource: "credential_provider.wif" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "acquire",
    failures: [
      { name: "MissingCredential", condition: "secret_or_source_missing", http_status: 404, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false },
      { name: "InsufficientScope", condition: "token_missing_required_scope", http_status: 403, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }
    ]
  },
  {
    capability: "validate",
    failures: [{ name: "Expired", condition: "token_expired", http_status: 401, recoverable: true, retry_safe: false }]
  }
]

interface CredentialProvider {

  // Acquire a credential for a named secret.
  // The flow parameter selects the acquisition strategy (WorkloadIdentity,
  // Stored, PlatformInjected, etc.). The concrete provider implementation
  // handles the protocol-specific steps (OIDC, STS, impersonation, etc.).
  capability acquire(
    secret_name: NonEmptyStr,
    flow: CredentialFlow,
    scheme: AuthScheme = Bearer,
    source_id: NonEmptyStr,
    required_scopes: List<String>
  ) -> { token: AccessToken }
    idempotent
    readonly

  // Check if a credential is still valid (non-expired).
  capability validate(token: AccessToken) -> { valid: Bool, expires_in: Int? }

  // Behavioral contracts
}

// interfaces/issue_provider.dag -- Abstract issue management interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for issue lifecycle management. The SDLC
// pipeline imports this interface — never concrete implementations.
//
// Implementations:
//   GitHubIssueProvider  (@rest api.github.com)  — local, cloud_run profiles
//   StubIssueProvider    (in-memory)              — unit_test profile
//
// Addresses: Gap A from e2e-gap-analysis.md
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.1

module interfaces.issue_provider

import std.types {
    TrackedIssue, IssueState, IssueLifecycleStage, NonEmptyStr, Url, Timestamp
}
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { DeliveryGuarantee }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

// IssueEvent represents a single event in an issue's history.
type IssueEvent {
  event_type:     NonEmptyStr       // "labeled", "unlabeled", "commented", etc.
  actor:          NonEmptyStr       // Who performed the action
  timestamp:      Timestamp
  payload:        Json?             // Event-specific data

  { scope: Api, level: Write, resource: "github.issues.write" }

  }
]

interface IssueProvider {

  // --- Discovery -----------------------------------------------------------

  capability discover(labels: List<String>, state: IssueState?)
    -> { issues: List<TrackedIssue> }
    readonly

  // --- Single issue --------------------------------------------------------

  capability get(id: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { issue: TrackedIssue, found: Bool }
    idempotent
    readonly

  // --- Mutations -----------------------------------------------------------

  capability create(title: NonEmptyStr, body: String, labels: List<String>)
    -> { issue: TrackedIssue }

  capability comment(id: NonEmptyStr, body: String, marker: NonEmptyStr?)
    -> { comment_id: NonEmptyStr, ok: Bool }
    idempotent

  capability set_labels(id: NonEmptyStr, labels: List<String>)
    -> { ok: Bool }

  capability close(id: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { ok: Bool }

  // --- Events (for audit trail) --------------------------------------------

  capability list_events(id: NonEmptyStr, since: String?)
    -> { events: List<IssueEvent> }
    readonly

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------
  //
  // discover: must support label filtering. Empty label list returns all managed issues.
  // comment with marker: if a comment with the same marker already exists, update it.
  // set_labels: replaces the full label set (not additive).
  // close: idempotent — closing an already-closed issue is success.

}

// interfaces/outcome_ledger.dag -- Abstract stage outcome ledger interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for durable stage outcome storage. The
// outcome ledger is the source of truth for "what happened" in the pipeline.
//
// Implementations:
//   FileOutcomeLedger      (local JSON files)  — local profile
//   GcsOutcomeLedger       (GCS objects)       — cloud_run profile
//   InMemoryOutcomeLedger  (HashMap)           — unit_test profile
//
// Addresses: Gap B from e2e-gap-analysis.md
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.3

module interfaces.outcome_ledger

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, StageOutcome }
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { CasMechanism, DeliveryGuarantee }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data cas_mechanism: CasMechanism = GenerationBased
data delivery_guarantee: DeliveryGuarantee = AtLeastOnce

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "upsert",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_key", "stage", "outcome.content_hash"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "same_run_stage_different_content_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "same content hash is no-op success", trigger: "duplicate_write", severity: Low }],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "ledger write access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["content_hash is stable canonical digest of outcome payload"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "get",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["run_key", "stage"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "ledger read access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: [],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "list_by_issue",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: ReadOnly,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["issue_id"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "result spans multiple runs and stages and may require paging", trigger: "large_history", severity: Medium }],
      confidence: HighConfidence,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "ledger read access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["Outcome records preserve causal ordering metadata"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Storage, level: Write, resource: "outcome_ledger.upsert" },
  { scope: Storage, level: Read, resource: "outcome_ledger.read" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "upsert",
    failures: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "same_run_stage_different_content_hash", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  }
]

interface OutcomeLedger {

  // Upsert a stage outcome. Idempotent: same run_key + stage + matching
  // content_hash is a no-op success. Different content_hash is fail-closed.
  capability upsert(
    run_key:  NonEmptyStr,
    stage:    NonEmptyStr,
    outcome:  StageOutcome
  ) -> { updated: Bool, previous: StageOutcome? }
    idempotent

  // Retrieve the outcome for a specific run_key + stage.
  capability get(
    run_key:  NonEmptyStr,
    stage:    NonEmptyStr
  ) -> { found: Bool, outcome: StageOutcome? }
    idempotent
    readonly

  // List all outcomes for a given issue (across all runs and stages).
  capability list_by_issue(
    issue_id: NonEmptyStr
  ) -> { outcomes: List<StageOutcome> }
    readonly

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------
  //
  // INV-12: Idempotent upsert — same run_key + stage + content_hash = success.
  // INV-13: Conflict detection — same run_key + stage + different content_hash = fail-closed.
  // INV-14: Retry budget is ledger-backed, not memory-only.
  // INV-15: Terminal states are terminal — no further transitions after TerminalFailed or Success.

}

// interfaces/signal_store.dag -- Abstract signal store interface.
//
// Provider-fungible contract for durable at-least-once signal delivery.
// Signals accelerate work discovery; periodic store scans provide anti-entropy.
//
// Implementations:
//   FileSignalStore      (local JSON files)  — local profile
//   PubSubSignalStore    (GCP Pub/Sub)       — cloud_run profile
//   InMemorySignalStore  (VecDeque)          — unit_test profile
//
// Canonical reference: domain-modeling-comprehensive.md §4.5

module interfaces.signal_store

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, Signal, SignalType }
import std.behavioral {
  OperationBehavior, FailureMode, SideEffects, Determinism, Confidence, PrerequisiteKind, Severity,
  CapabilityBehaviorContract, CapabilityFailureContract
}
import std.coordination { DeliveryGuarantee, QueueSemantics, QueueOrdering }
import std.capability { CapabilityRequirement, InfraScope, AccessLevel }

data delivery_guarantee: DeliveryGuarantee = AtLeastOnce

data queue_semantics: QueueSemantics = {
  ordering: Unordered,
  visibility_timeout_seconds: 300,
  dead_letter: { max_attempts: 10, destination: "signals.dlq" }
}

data capability_behaviors: List<CapabilityBehaviorContract> = [
  {
    capability: "emit",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["signal.idempotency_key"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "duplicate_idempotency_key_with_different_payload", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "signal backend write access", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["idempotency key deduplicates equivalent logical signal"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "consume",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: false,
      idempotency_keys: null,
      determinism: NonDeterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [{ description: "duplicate, delayed, and reordered signals are expected", trigger: "distributed_delivery", severity: High }],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "consumer has claim/read access to queue", kind: Capability }],
      assumptions: ["authoritative state checks happen against store/ledger, not only signal stream"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  },
  {
    capability: "ack",
    behavior: {
      side_effects: WritesState,
      idempotent: true,
      idempotency_keys: ["idempotency_key"],
      determinism: Deterministic,
      failure_modes: [],
      edge_cases: [],
      confidence: Documented,
      prerequisites: [{ description: "consumer identity can ack consumed signals", kind: Runtime }],
      assumptions: ["acking an already-acked signal is no-op success"],
      unknowns: []
    }
  }
]

data capability_requirements: List<CapabilityRequirement> = [
  { scope: Queue, level: Write, resource: "signal_store.emit" },
  { scope: Queue, level: Read, resource: "signal_store.consume" }
]

data capability_failure_contracts: List<CapabilityFailureContract> = [
  {
    capability: "emit",
    failures: [{ name: "Conflict", condition: "duplicate_idempotency_key_with_different_payload", http_status: 409, recoverable: false, retry_safe: false }]
  }
]

interface SignalStore {

  // Emit a signal. Idempotent: dedup by idempotency_key.
  capability emit(signal: Signal)
    -> { emitted: Bool }
    idempotent

  // Consume signals of specified types. Returns unconsumed signals
  // up to the specified limit.
  capability consume(signal_types: List<SignalType>, limit: Int?)
    -> { signals: List<Signal> }

  // Acknowledge a consumed signal. Idempotent: acking an already-acked
  // signal is a no-op success.
  capability ack(idempotency_key: NonEmptyStr)
    -> { acked: Bool }
    idempotent

  // --- Behavioral contracts ------------------------------------------------
  //
  // INV-18: Signal consumption is idempotent against authoritative store state.
  // INV-19: Periodic store-driven scans are mandatory anti-entropy (deployment concern).
  // Controllers tolerate duplicate, delayed, and reordered signals.

}
