# dsl/services/github/issues.dag
```
// services/github/issues.dag -- GitHub Issues & Comments API.
//
// The issue is the central coordination object for the SDLC pipeline.
// An issue IS a pipeline instance: its labels encode lifecycle stage,
// its comments carry artifacts (designs, reviews, reports), and its
// state transitions drive pipeline progression.
//
// Design principle: issues are the PRIMARY INTERFACE. A human posts
// an idea as an issue; the infra picks it up, generates a design,
// reviews it, tracks implementation, and closes it when done. The
// repo feels alive because issues are addressed autonomously.
//
// Transport pattern (same as gist.dag, llm/*.dag):
//   Pure prepare → REST execute (I/O boundary) → Pure parse
//
// Follows: services/github/gist.dag (same endpoint, auth, conventions)
//
// Implements: interfaces.issue_provider.IssueProvider
// Profiles: local, cloud_run

module services.github.issues

import interfaces.issue_provider { IssueProvider, IssueEvent }
import std.types { TrackedIssue, IssueState, IssueLifecycleStage, NonEmptyStr, Url }
import std.errors { GitHubErrorShape }
import extdeps.github.issues { GitHubIssue, GitHubIssueState, Label, IssueComment }
import extdeps.github.core { GitHubUser, Repository, Pagination }

service github.Issues : IssueProvider {
  config {
    endpoint: "https://api.github.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    // GitHub API rate limits: 5000 requests/hour for authenticated users
    rate_limit: { requests: 5000, per: hour, scope: core }
    // Retry on rate limit and server errors with exponential backoff
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504] }
  }

  // --- Core CRUD ---------------------------------------------------------

  operation create {
    input {
      title: NonEmptyStr
      body: String
      labels: List<String>
    }
    output {
      issue: TrackedIssue from "."
    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues" }
    response {
      201 => TrackedIssue
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation get {
    input {
      id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output {
      issue: TrackedIssue from "."
      found: Bool from "status == 200"
    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}" }
    response {
      200 => TrackedIssue
      301 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      410 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation close {
    input {
      id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output {
      ok: Bool from "state == \"closed\""
    }
    transport rest { method: PATCH, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}" }
    response {
      200 => TrackedIssue
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Comments ----------------------------------------------------------
  // Comments are the artifact carrier: designs, reviews, and reports
  // are posted as issue comments with structured markdown.

  operation comment {
    input {
      id: NonEmptyStr
      body: String
      marker: NonEmptyStr?
    }
    output {
      comment_id: NonEmptyStr from "id"
      ok: Bool from "id != 0"
    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/comments" }
    response {
      201 => IssueComment
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Labels (lifecycle stage transitions) ------------------------------
  // Labels encode the issue lifecycle stage. Transitions are:
  //   idea → design → design-review → accepted → implementing →
  //   code-review → testing → done

  operation set_labels {
    input {
      id: NonEmptyStr
      labels: List<String>
    }
    output {
      ok: Bool from "status == 200"
    }
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/labels" }
    response {
      200 => List<Label>
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Listing (for polling / batch processing) --------------------------

  operation discover {
    input {
      labels: List<String>
      state: IssueState? = Open
    }
    output {
      issues: List<TrackedIssue>
    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues" }
    response {
      200 => List<TrackedIssue>
      301 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation list_events {
    input {
      id: NonEmptyStr
      since: String?
    }
    output {
      events: List<IssueEvent>
    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/events" }
    response {
      200 => List<IssueEvent>
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      410 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture github_auth {
    mock cloud_env.config -> { provider: "github", runtime: "local-dev" }
    mock cloud_env.credential -> { token: "<MOCK_GH_TOKEN>", source_type: "static", scheme: "bearer" }
}

test create_issue : github_auth {

    input create/prepare.owner -> "gunb-ai"
    input create/prepare.repo -> "gunbc"
    input create/prepare.title -> "Implement feature X"
    input create/prepare.body -> "## Problem\n\nWe need feature X.\n\n## Approach\n\nUse DAG composition."
    input create/prepare.labels -> ["idea"]

    mock create/execute.response -> rest_response(201, {
        number: 42,
        html_url: "https://github.com/gunb-ai/gunbc/issues/42",
        id: 1234567,
        node_id: "I_mock"
    })

    expect result.number == 42
    expect result.url contains "issues/42"
}

test add_comment : github_auth {

    input comment/prepare.owner -> "gunb-ai"
    input comment/prepare.repo -> "gunbc"
    input comment/prepare.number -> 42
    input comment/prepare.body -> "## Design\n\nHere is the generated design..."

    mock comment/execute.response -> rest_response(201, {
        id: 999,
        html_url: "https://github.com/gunb-ai/gunbc/issues/42#issuecomment-999"
    })

    expect result.id == 999
}

test list_issues_by_label : github_auth {

    input list/prepare.owner -> "gunb-ai"
    input list/prepare.repo -> "gunbc"
    input list/prepare.labels -> "idea"
    input list/prepare.state -> "open"

    mock list/execute.response -> rest_response(200, [
        { number: 1, title: "Feature A", labels: [{ name: "idea" }], state: "open" },
        { number: 2, title: "Feature B", labels: [{ name: "idea" }], state: "open" }
    ])

    expect result.issues is List
}

// services/github/pull_request.dag -- GitHub Pull Request API.
//
// Complements issues.dag for the implementation stage of the SDLC
// pipeline. Once an agent pushes code, the pipeline creates a PR,
// requests reviews, and merges on approval.
//
// Transport pattern (same as issues.dag, gist.dag):
//   Pure prepare → REST execute (I/O boundary) → Pure parse

module services.github.pull_request

import extdeps.github.pull_requests {
  PullRequest, PrState, PrBranchRef, PrMergeStrategy,
  Review, ReviewState, PrFile, PrFileStatus,
  CheckStatus, CheckConclusion
}
import extdeps.github.core { GitHubUser, Repository }
import std.errors { GitHubErrorShape }

service github.PullRequest {
  config {
    endpoint: "https://api.github.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    // GitHub API rate limits: 5000 requests/hour for authenticated users
    rate_limit: { requests: 5000, per: hour, scope: core }
    // Retry on rate limit and server errors with exponential backoff
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504] }
  }

  operation Create {
    input {
      owner: String
      repo: String
      title: String
      body: String
      head: String
      base: String = "main"
      draft: Bool = false
    }
    output {
      number: Int from "number"
      url: String from "html_url"
      id: Int from "id"
      node_id: String from "node_id"
      head_sha: String from "head/sha"
    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/pulls" }
    response {
      201 => PullRequest
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation Get {
    input {
      owner: String
      repo: String
      number: Int
    }
    output {
      number: Int from "number"
      title: String from "title"
      body: String from "body"
      state: String from "state"
      url: String from "html_url"
      head_sha: String from "head/sha"
      base_ref: String from "base/ref"
      mergeable: Bool? from "mergeable"
      merged: Bool from "merged"
    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/pulls/\{number\}" }
    response {
      200 => PullRequest
      301 => GitHubErrorShape

    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{number\}/comments" }
    response {
      201 => Json
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation Merge {

      message: String from "message"
    }
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/pulls/\{number\}/merge" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      405 => GitHubErrorShape
      409 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation ListFiles {
    input {
      owner: String
      repo: String
      number: Int
      per_page: Int = 100
    }
    output {
      files: Json
    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/pulls/\{number\}/files" }
    response {
      200 => List<PrFile>
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape

  operation RequestReview {

    }
    output {
      url: String from "html_url"
    }

    response {
      201 => PullRequest
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape

  }

  operation ListReviews {

    }

    }
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/pulls/\{number\}/reviews" }
    response {

      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// services/review/dimension.dag -- Review dimension operations.
//
// Pure operations for the four-dimension review pipeline (D-1).
// Each operation is a domain-specific computation (prompt generation,
// response parsing, output merging) that runs locally -- no network I/O.
//
// These replace the Rust implementations in:
//   lib/review/src/dimension.rs (DimensionOps)
//   lib/review/src/lib.rs (ReviewOps)

module services.review.dimension

service review.Dimension {

  operation PrepareDimensionPrompt {
    input {
      artifact: String
      criteria: Json
      dimension: String
      depth: String
      prior_findings: String?
    }
    output {
      question: String
      system_prompt: String
    }
    transport local {}
  }

  operation ParseDimensionResponse {
    input {
      answer: String
      criteria: Json
      dimension: String
    }
    output {
      output: Json
      errors: Json
    }
    transport local {}
  }

  operation FormatDiffArtifact {
    input {
      diff_files: Json
    }
    output {
      artifact: String
    }
    transport local {}
  }

  operation FormatPriorFindings {
    input {
      coherence_output: Json?
      quality_output: Json?
      requirements_output: Json?
    }
    output {
      prior_findings: String
    }
    transport local {}
  }

  operation MergeDimensionOutputs {
    input {
      coherence_output: Json?
      quality_output: Json?
      requirements_output: Json?
      aspirational_output: Json?
    }
    output {
      output: Json
      summary: String
    }
    transport local {}
  }
}

// services/sdlc/providers/codex_agent_provider.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: CodexAgentProvider implements AgentProvider.
//
// Wraps the Codex CLI for agent dispatch via @shell transport.
// The interface contract is generic enough to swap for any agent
// runner (Devin, SWE-bench, local LLM agent, etc.).
//
// Gap I partial resolution: concrete agent provider with branch management.

module services.sdlc.providers.codex_agent_provider

import interfaces.agent_provider { AgentProvider }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, AgentStatus, ApprovalMode }

// =========================================================================
// CodexAgentProvider : AgentProvider
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile bindings: local, cloud_run
// Transport: @shell (CLI subprocess)
// Auth: inherits from environment (CODEX_API_KEY)

service codex.AgentProvider : AgentProvider {

  operation spawn {
    input {
      prompt: String
      repo_path: String
      branch: NonEmptyStr
      model: String?
      timeout_seconds: Int?
      approval_mode: ApprovalMode?
    }
    output {
      run_id: NonEmptyStr
      status: AgentStatus
      started: Bool
    }
    // Only required args in base argv; optional --model and --approval-mode
    // are resolved by the executor when the optional inputs are present.
    transport shell { argv: ["codex", "-C", "\{repo_path\}", "\{prompt\}"] }
  }

  operation poll {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { status: AgentStatus, finished: Bool, exit_code: Int?, error: String? }
    readonly
    transport shell { argv: ["codex", "status", "\{run_id\}"] }
  }

  operation cancel {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr, reason: String? }
    output { cancelled: Bool, final_status: AgentStatus }
    transport shell { argv: ["codex", "cancel", "\{run_id\}"] }
  }

  operation get_result {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { status: AgentStatus, exit_code: Int?, stdout: String?, stderr: String?, files_changed: List<String> }
    readonly
    transport shell { argv: ["codex", "result", "\{run_id\}"] }
  }
}

// services/sdlc/providers/file_claim_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: FileClaimStore implements ClaimStore.
//
// Uses local JSON files for claim persistence. Single-machine only.
// CAS is achieved via OS-level file locking (generation counters).
//
// Gap B resolution: replaces the ControlPlane REST service with a
// direct file-based implementation that needs no server.

module services.sdlc.providers.file_claim_store

import interfaces.claim_store { ClaimStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr }
import std.resources { Filesystem, Clock }

// =========================================================================
// FileClaimStore : ClaimStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: local
// Storage: JSON files in $SDLC_LEDGER_DIR/claims/
// CAS: generation counter persisted per (issue_id, stage) file
//
// File layout:
//   {dir}/claims/{issue_id_hash}/{stage}.json
//   Contents: { owner, generation, acquired_at, expires_at, lease_ttl_ms }

service file.ClaimStore : ClaimStore {

  config {
    dir: String = "target/sdlc/claims"
  }

  operation acquire {
    input {
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      lease_ttl_ms: Int
    }
    output {
      acquired: Bool
      conflict: Bool
      lease_generation: Int
    }
    idempotent
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/claims/\{issue_id\}/\{stage\}.json" }
  }

  operation heartbeat {
    input {
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      generation: Int
    }
    output { accepted: Bool }
    idempotent
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/claims/\{issue_id\}/\{stage\}.json" }
  }

  operation release {
    input {
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      generation: Int
    }
    output { released: Bool }
    transport file { op: DELETE, path: "\{dir\}/claims/\{issue_id\}/\{stage\}.json" }
  }

  operation list_active {
    input {}
    output {
      claims: List<{
        issue_id: String,
        stage: String,
        owner: String,
        generation: Int,
        acquired_at_epoch_ms: Int,
        last_heartbeat_epoch_ms: Int,
        expires_at_epoch_ms: Int
      }>
    }
    readonly
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/claims/" }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test file_claim_acquire_release {

    input acquire/prepare.issue_id -> "42"
    input acquire/prepare.stage -> "design"
    input acquire/prepare.owner -> "worker-1"
    input acquire/prepare.lease_ttl_ms -> 30000

    mock acquire/execute.response -> file_response(0, {
        acquired: true,
        conflict: false,
        lease_generation: 1
    })

    expect result.acquired == true
    expect result.conflict == false
}

// services/sdlc/providers/file_outcome_ledger.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: FileOutcomeLedger implements OutcomeLedger.
//
// Uses local JSON files for outcome persistence. Idempotent upsert
// with content-hash collision detection.
//
// Gap B resolution: replaces the ControlPlane REST endpoint with
// direct file I/O.

module services.sdlc.providers.file_outcome_ledger

import interfaces.outcome_ledger { OutcomeLedger }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, StageOutcome }
import std.resources { Filesystem }

// =========================================================================
// FileOutcomeLedger : OutcomeLedger
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: local
// Storage: JSON files in $SDLC_LEDGER_DIR/outcomes/
//
// File layout:
//   {dir}/outcomes/{run_key_hash}/{stage}.json
//   Contents: StageOutcome serialized as JSON

service file.OutcomeLedger : OutcomeLedger {

  config {
    dir: String = "target/sdlc/outcomes"
  }

  operation upsert {
    input {
      run_key: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      outcome: StageOutcome
    }
    output {
      updated: Bool
      previous: StageOutcome?
    }
    idempotent
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/outcomes/\{run_key\}/\{stage\}.json" }
  }

  operation get {
    input {
      run_key: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output {
      found: Bool
      outcome: StageOutcome?
    }
    idempotent
    readonly
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/outcomes/\{run_key\}/\{stage\}.json" }
  }

  operation list_by_issue {
    input { issue_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { outcomes: List<StageOutcome> }
    readonly
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/outcomes/\{issue_id\}/" }
  }
}

// services/sdlc/providers/file_signal_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: FileSignalStore implements SignalStore.
//
// Uses local JSON files for signal persistence. Single-machine only.
// Signals are stored as individual files keyed by idempotency_key.
// Consumption reads the directory; ack deletes the file.
//
// Profile binding: local

module services.sdlc.providers.file_signal_store

import interfaces.signal_store { SignalStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, Signal, SignalType }

// =========================================================================
// FileSignalStore : SignalStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: local
// Storage: JSON files in {dir}/signals/
// File layout:
//   {dir}/signals/{idempotency_key}.json
//   Contents: Signal { type, idempotency_key, payload, created_at }

service file.SignalStore : SignalStore {

  config {
    dir: String = "target/sdlc/signals"
  }

  operation emit {
    input { signal: Signal }
    output { emitted: Bool }
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/signals/\{signal.idempotency_key\}.json" }
  }

  operation consume {
    input { signal_types: List<SignalType>, limit: Int? }
    output { signals: List<Signal> }
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/signals/" }
  }

  operation ack {
    input { idempotency_key: NonEmptyStr }
    output { acked: Bool }
    transport file { op: DELETE, path: "\{dir\}/signals/\{idempotency_key\}.json" }
  }
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/gcp_credential_provider.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/gcp_credential_provider.dag
//
// Concrete CredentialProvider implementation for GCP (D-2).
// Uses the credential_chain pattern from std/patterns.dag.
// Bound via profile: `bind CredentialProvider -> GcpWifCredentialProvider`.
//
// Replaces: lib/cloud-ops/src/graph.rs (502 lines) -- provider dispatch
//           lib/gcp-ops/src/graph.rs (1,674 lines) -- GCP credential chain
//
// SP-1: Full WIF OIDC -> STS token exchange -> impersonation -> scoped access token.
// The credential_chain pattern handles all 5 steps; this service wires
// it to the CredentialProvider interface with profile-bound config.
//
// SC-6: Transport wired. acquire delegates to credential_chain pattern which
// calls gcp.STS.Exchange, gcp.SecretManager.AccessVersion, github.OIDC.GetToken,
// gcp.Metadata.GetIdentityToken, and shell.GCloud.AuthPrintAccessToken (local
// dev fallback). All underlying services have real REST/shell transport blocks.

module services.sdlc.providers.gcp_credential_provider

import std.types {
  AccessToken, AuthScheme, CloudRuntime, CredentialFlow, NonEmptyStr,
  ProjectId, ServiceAccountEmail, EpochMs
}
import std.patterns { credential_chain }
import std.resources { Network }
import std.errors { GcpErrorShape, GitHubErrorShape }
import interfaces.credential_provider { CredentialProvider }
import services.gcp.sts { gcp.STS }
import services.gcp.secret_manager { gcp.SecretManager }
import services.shell { shell.GCloud, shell.Env }

// Extract the service account from the WorkloadIdentity flow variant.
// Returns None for non-WIF flows (Stored, PlatformInjected, etc.).
fn extract_service_account(flow: CredentialFlow) -> ServiceAccountEmail? {
  match flow {
    WorkloadIdentity { service_account } => service_account
    _ => None
  }
}

// Extract scopes from the flow, falling back to required_scopes parameter.
fn resolve_scopes(flow: CredentialFlow, required_scopes: List<String>) -> List<String> {
  match flow {
    WorkloadIdentity { scopes } => if scopes |> count() > 0 { scopes } else { required_scopes }
    InteractiveAuth { scopes }  => if scopes |> count() > 0 { scopes } else { required_scopes }
    _ => required_scopes
  }
}

service GcpWifCredentialProvider : CredentialProvider {
  config {
    runtime: CloudRuntime
    project_id: ProjectId
    audience: NonEmptyStr = "sigstore"
  }

  // SC-6: acquire wires to credential_chain pattern via REST transport.
  // Transport chain (all have real transport blocks):
  //   1. github.OIDC.GetToken (REST)     — GitHub Actions OIDC token
  //   2. gcp.Metadata.GetIdentityToken   — GCE/Cloud Run metadata server
  //   3. gcp.STS.Exchange (REST)          — federated token exchange
  //   4. gcp.IAM.GenerateAccessToken      — SA impersonation
  //   5. gcp.SecretManager.AccessVersion  — secret retrieval
  //   6. shell.GCloud.AuthPrintAccessToken — local dev fallback (shell)
  operation acquire {
    input {
      secret_name: NonEmptyStr
      flow: CredentialFlow
      scheme: AuthScheme = Bearer
      source_id: NonEmptyStr
      required_scopes: List<String>
    }
    output {
      token: AccessToken
    }
    idempotent
    readonly
    uses net: Network
  }

  // validate checks token expiry without network call.
  // AccessToken carries expires_at metadata from the credential chain.
  // Pure operation — no transport needed.
  operation validate {
    input { token: AccessToken }
    output { valid: Bool, expires_in: Int? }
    readonly
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture gcp_wif_env {
  mock config.runtime -> GitHubActions
  mock config.project_id -> "mock-project"
  mock config.audience -> "sigstore"
}

// SP-1: Full WIF credential chain test (GitHub Actions OIDC).
test gcp_wif_acquire_github_oidc : gcp_wif_env {

    input acquire.secret_name -> "github-token"
    input acquire.flow -> WorkloadIdentity {
      audience: "sigstore",
      service_account: "ci@mock-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
      scopes: ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    }
    input acquire.source_id -> "github"
    input acquire.required_scopes -> ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]

    // Step 1: GitHub OIDC token acquisition
    mock env_get_url.response -> { value: "https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com" }
    mock env_get_token.response -> { value: "mock-request-token" }
    mock execute_github_oidc.response -> rest_response(200, { value: "mock-oidc-jwt" })

    // Step 2: STS token exchange
    mock execute_sts.response -> rest_response(200, {
      access_token: "mock-federated-token",
      expires_in: 3600,
      token_type: "Bearer"
    })

    // Step 3: SA impersonation
    mock execute_impersonate.response -> rest_response(200, {
      accessToken: "mock-sa-access-token",
      expireTime: "2099-01-01T00:00:00Z"
    })

    // Step 4: Secret Manager access
    mock execute_secret_access.response -> rest_response(200, {
      payload: { data: "bW9jay1naXRodWItdG9rZW4=" }
    })

    expect result.token is Map
    expect result.token.token is NonEmpty
}

// SP-1: Credential chain with metadata server (GCE/Cloud Run runtime).
test gcp_wif_acquire_metadata_oidc : gcp_wif_env {

    input acquire.secret_name -> "github-token"
    input acquire.flow -> WorkloadIdentity {
      audience: "sigstore",
      service_account: None,
      scopes: []
    }
    input acquire.source_id -> "gcp-metadata"
    input acquire.required_scopes -> ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]

    // Step 1: Metadata server identity token
    mock execute_metadata_oidc.response -> rest_response(200, "mock-metadata-identity-token")

    // Step 2: STS token exchange
    mock execute_sts.response -> rest_response(200, {
      access_token: "mock-federated-token",
      expires_in: 3600,
      token_type: "Bearer"
    })

    // Step 3: No impersonation (service_account is None)

    // Step 4: Secret Manager access
    mock execute_secret_access.response -> rest_response(200, {
      payload: { data: "bW9jay1naXRodWItdG9rZW4=" }
    })

    expect result.token is Map
}

// SP-1: Local dev credential flow (ADC + gcloud fallback).
test gcp_wif_acquire_local_dev : gcp_wif_env {

    input acquire.secret_name -> "github-token"
    input acquire.flow -> InteractiveAuth {
      scopes: ["https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform"]
    }
    input acquire.source_id -> "local-dev"
    input acquire.required_scopes -> []

    // ADC file check
    mock env_get_adc.response -> { value: "~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json" }
    mock execute_adc_read.response -> file_response("~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json")

    // OAuth2 refresh
    mock execute_oauth_refresh.response -> rest_response(200, {
      access_token: "mock-local-token",
      expires_in: 3600
    })

    // Secret Manager access
    mock execute_secret_access.response -> rest_response(200, {
      payload: { data: "bW9jay1naXRodWItdG9rZW4=" }
    })

    expect result.token is Map
}

// SP-1: Token validation (non-expired).
test gcp_wif_validate_valid {

    input validate.token -> {
      token: "mock-token",
      scheme: "Bearer",
      source_id: "github",
      expires_at: 9999999999999
    }

    expect result.valid == true
    expect result.expires_in > 0
}

// SP-1: Token validation (expired).
test gcp_wif_validate_expired {

    input validate.token -> {
      token: "mock-expired-token",
      scheme: "Bearer",
      source_id: "github",
      expires_at: 1000000000000
    }

    expect result.valid == false
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/gcs_artifact_store.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/gcs_artifact_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: GcsArtifactStore implements ArtifactStore.
//
// Uses GCS objects for durable artifact storage with content-hash-based
// deduplication. Two-phase commit via provisional/canonical markers.
//
// Object layout:
//   gs://{bucket}/artifacts/{artifact_id}              — artifact content
//   gs://{bucket}/markers/{run_key}/{type}/{kind}.json — lifecycle markers
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run
//
// CAS wiring status (as of 2026-02-28):
//   The store operation's content-hash dedup relies on GCS preconditions
//   (x-goog-if-generation-match), but the compiler does not inject these
//   headers from input fields. Tests mock 412 conflict responses to verify
//   parse-layer handling, but the precondition is not compiler-enforced.
//   See: tasks.md RT-PC1 (parameterized header injection)

module services.sdlc.providers.gcs_artifact_store

import interfaces.artifact_store { ArtifactStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, ArtifactPayload, ArtifactType, ArtifactMarker }
import std.errors { GcpErrorShape }

// =========================================================================
// GcsArtifactStore : ArtifactStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run
// Storage: GCS objects in gs://{bucket}/artifacts/ and gs://{bucket}/markers/
// CAS: GCS generation-based for idempotent store (same content_hash = success)

service gcs.ArtifactStore : ArtifactStore {

  config {
    bucket: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: NonEmptyStr
    endpoint: "https://storage.googleapis.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    auth_input: access_token
    rate_limit: { requests: 1000, per: minute, scope: gcs_artifacts }
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 503] }
  }

  operation store {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      artifact_id: NonEmptyStr
      payload: ArtifactPayload
      content_hash: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { stored: Bool, conflict: Bool }
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/upload/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?uploadType=media&name=artifacts/\{artifact_id\}" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation retrieve {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      artifact_id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { found: Bool, payload: ArtifactPayload?, content_hash: NonEmptyStr? }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o/artifacts%2F\{artifact_id\}?alt=media" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      404 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation store_marker {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      marker: ArtifactMarker
    }
    output { stored: Bool }
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/upload/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?uploadType=media&name=markers/\{marker.run_key\}/\{marker.artifact_type\}/\{marker.kind\}.json" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation get_canonical_marker {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      run_key: NonEmptyStr
      artifact_type: ArtifactType
    }
    output { found: Bool, marker: ArtifactMarker? }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o/markers%2F\{run_key\}%2F\{artifact_type\}%2FCanonical.json?alt=media" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      404 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// -- Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture gcs_auth {
    mock cloud_env.config -> { provider: "gcp", runtime: "cloud-run" }
    mock cloud_env.credential -> { token: "<MOCK_GCS_TOKEN>", source_type: "static", scheme: "bearer" }
}

test gcs_artifact_store_success : gcs_auth {

    input store/prepare.artifact_id -> "art-001"
    input store/prepare.content_hash -> "sha256:abc123"

    mock store/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
        name: "artifacts/art-001",
        generation: "1706745600000000"
    })

    expect result.stored == true
    expect result.conflict == false
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/gcs_claim_store.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/gcs_claim_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: GcsClaimStore implements ClaimStore.
//
// Uses GCS objects with generation-based CAS for multi-worker mutual
// exclusion. Each (issue_id, stage) pair maps to a GCS object whose
// generation number serves as the optimistic lock.
//
// CAS mechanism:
//   - acquire: write with `x-goog-if-generation-match: 0` (create-only)
//     or with matching generation (re-acquire expired lease)
//   - heartbeat: write with `x-goog-if-generation-match: {generation}`
//   - release: delete with `x-goog-if-generation-match: {generation}`
//
// Gap E resolution: generation-based CAS for multi-worker claim safety.
//
// CAS wiring status (as of 2026-02-28):
//   The DSL declares CAS intent (generation parameters, 412 test scenarios),
//   but the compiler does NOT yet inject x-goog-if-generation-match headers
//   from input fields. The lowerer generates static headers only. Until
//   parameterized header support exists, the Rust worker must construct the
//   precondition header at runtime from the generation input. Tests mock the
//   412 response, which validates parse-layer conflict handling, but the
//   actual header injection is not compiler-verified.
//   See: tasks.md RT-PC1 (parameterized header injection)

module services.sdlc.providers.gcs_claim_store

import interfaces.claim_store { ClaimStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr }
import std.errors { GcpErrorShape }

// =========================================================================
// GcsClaimStore : ClaimStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run
// Storage: GCS objects in gs://{bucket}/claims/{issue_id}/{stage}.json
// CAS: GCS object generation (x-goog-if-generation-match header)
//
// Object layout:
//   gs://{bucket}/claims/{issue_id}/{stage}.json
//   Contents: { owner, generation, acquired_at_epoch_ms, expires_at_epoch_ms, lease_ttl_ms }
//
// Generation semantics:
//   - Generation 0 means "object does not exist" (first acquire)
//   - Each successful write increments the generation
//   - x-goog-if-generation-match: N fails with 412 if current != N

service gcs.ClaimStore : ClaimStore {

  config {
    bucket: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: NonEmptyStr
    endpoint: "https://storage.googleapis.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    auth_input: access_token
    rate_limit: { requests: 1000, per: minute, scope: gcs_claims }
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 503] }
  }

  operation acquire {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      lease_ttl_ms: Int
      expected_generation: Int = 0   // 0 = create-only; >0 = re-acquire expired lease
    }
    output {
      acquired: Bool
      conflict: Bool
      lease_generation: Int
    }
    idempotent
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/upload/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?uploadType=media&name=claims/\{issue_id\}/\{stage\}.json" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation heartbeat {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      generation: Int
    }
    output { accepted: Bool }
    idempotent
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/upload/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?uploadType=media&name=claims/\{issue_id\}/\{stage\}.json" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  // List all active claim objects under the claims/ prefix.
  // Used by anti-entropy reconciler (SR-7) to find stale claims.
  operation list_active {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
    }
    output {
      claims: List<{
        issue_id: String,
        stage: String,
        owner: String,
        generation: Int,
        acquired_at_epoch_ms: Int,
        last_heartbeat_epoch_ms: Int,
        expires_at_epoch_ms: Int
      }>
    }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?prefix=claims/" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation release {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      owner: NonEmptyStr
      generation: Int
    }
    output { released: Bool }
    transport rest { method: DELETE, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o/claims%2F\{issue_id\}%2F\{stage\}.json" }
    response {
      204 => Unit
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      404 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture gcs_auth {
    mock cloud_env.config -> { provider: "gcp", runtime: "cloud-run" }
    mock cloud_env.credential -> { token: "<MOCK_GCS_TOKEN>", source_type: "static", scheme: "bearer" }
}

test gcs_claim_acquire_success : gcs_auth {

    input acquire/prepare.issue_id -> "42"
    input acquire/prepare.stage -> "design"
    input acquire/prepare.owner -> "worker-1"
    input acquire/prepare.lease_ttl_ms -> 30000

    mock acquire/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
        name: "claims/42/design.json",
        generation: "1706745600000000",
        metageneration: "1"
    })

    expect result.acquired == true
    expect result.conflict == false
}

test gcs_claim_acquire_conflict : gcs_auth {

    input acquire/prepare.issue_id -> "42"
    input acquire/prepare.stage -> "design"
    input acquire/prepare.owner -> "worker-2"
    input acquire/prepare.lease_ttl_ms -> 30000

    // 412 Precondition Failed = another worker holds the claim
    mock acquire/execute.response -> rest_response(412, {
        error: {
            code: 412,
            message: "Precondition Failed",
            errors: [{ reason: "conditionNotMet" }]
        }
    })

    expect result.acquired == false
    expect result.conflict == true
}

test gcs_claim_release_success : gcs_auth {

    input release/prepare.issue_id -> "42"
    input release/prepare.stage -> "design"
    input release/prepare.owner -> "worker-1"
    input release/prepare.generation -> 1706745600000000

    mock release/execute.response -> rest_response(204, {})

    expect result.released == true
}

test gcs_claim_heartbeat_stale : gcs_auth {

    input heartbeat/prepare.issue_id -> "42"
    input heartbeat/prepare.stage -> "design"
    input heartbeat/prepare.owner -> "worker-1"
    input heartbeat/prepare.generation -> 1706745500000000

    // 412 = generation mismatch, lease was stolen
    mock heartbeat/execute.response -> rest_response(412, {
        error: { code: 412, message: "Precondition Failed" }
    })

    expect result.accepted == false
}

// services/sdlc/providers/gcs_outcome_ledger.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: GcsOutcomeLedger implements OutcomeLedger.
//
// Uses GCS objects for durable outcome storage. Idempotent upsert with
// content-hash collision detection via GCS preconditions.
//
// Object layout:
//   gs://{bucket}/outcomes/{run_key}/{stage}.json
//   Contents: StageOutcome serialized as JSON
//
// CAS for idempotent upsert:
//   - First write: x-goog-if-generation-match: 0 (create-only)
//   - Re-write with same content_hash: succeeds (idempotent replay)
//   - Re-write with different content_hash: fails (conflict)
//
// Gap E resolution: GCS generation-based CAS for outcome safety.
//
// CAS wiring status (as of 2026-02-28):
//   Same gap as gcs_claim_store.dag — the DSL declares CAS intent but the
//   compiler does not inject precondition headers from input fields.
//   See: tasks.md RT-PC1 (parameterized header injection)

module services.sdlc.providers.gcs_outcome_ledger

import interfaces.outcome_ledger { OutcomeLedger }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, StageOutcome }
import std.errors { GcpErrorShape }

// =========================================================================
// GcsOutcomeLedger : OutcomeLedger
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run
// Storage: GCS objects in gs://{bucket}/outcomes/
// CAS: GCS object generation for first-writer-wins

service gcs.OutcomeLedger : OutcomeLedger {

  config {
    bucket: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: NonEmptyStr
    endpoint: "https://storage.googleapis.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    auth_input: access_token
    rate_limit: { requests: 1000, per: minute, scope: gcs_outcomes }
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 503] }
  }

  operation upsert {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      run_key: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
      outcome: StageOutcome
    }
    output {
      updated: Bool
      previous: StageOutcome?
    }
    idempotent
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/upload/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?uploadType=media&name=outcomes/\{run_key\}/\{stage\}.json" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      412 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation get {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      run_key: NonEmptyStr
      stage: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output {
      found: Bool
      outcome: StageOutcome?
    }
    idempotent
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o/outcomes%2F\{run_key\}%2F\{stage\}.json?alt=media" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      404 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation list_by_issue {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      issue_id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { outcomes: List<StageOutcome> }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/storage/v1/b/\{bucket\}/o?prefix=outcomes/\{issue_id\}/" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture gcs_auth {
    mock cloud_env.config -> { provider: "gcp", runtime: "cloud-run" }
    mock cloud_env.credential -> { token: "<MOCK_GCS_TOKEN>", source_type: "static", scheme: "bearer" }
}

// services/sdlc/providers/github_issue_provider.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: GitHubIssueProvider implements IssueProvider.
//
// Wraps the existing github.Issues service operations to fulfill the
// IssueProvider interface contract. Transport is REST against api.github.com.
//
// Gap A resolution: promotes concrete service to interface implementation.
// Step 6 (gap analysis): real GitHub transport for enhanced dry-run.

module services.sdlc.providers.github_issue_provider

import interfaces.issue_provider { IssueProvider, IssueEvent }
import std.types { TrackedIssue, IssueState, NonEmptyStr, Url }
import std.errors { GitHubErrorShape }

// =========================================================================
// GitHubIssueProvider : IssueProvider
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile bindings: local, cloud_run
// Credential: env("GITHUB_TOKEN") for local, secret("github-token") for cloud_run

service github.IssueProvider : IssueProvider {

  config {
    endpoint: "https://api.github.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    auth_input: auth_token
    owner: NonEmptyStr                 // GitHub org or user
    repo: NonEmptyStr                  // Repository name
    rate_limit: { requests: 5000, per: hour, scope: core }
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 502, 503, 504] }
  }

  // --- Discovery ---------------------------------------------------------

  operation discover {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      labels: List<String>
      state: IssueState?
    }
    output {
      issues: List<TrackedIssue>
    }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues" }
    response {
      200 => List<TrackedIssue>
      301 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Single issue ------------------------------------------------------

  operation get {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output {
      issue: TrackedIssue from "."
      found: Bool from "status == 200"
    }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}" }
    response {
      200 => TrackedIssue
      301 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      410 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Create ------------------------------------------------------------

  operation create {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      title: NonEmptyStr
      body: String
      labels: List<String>
    }
    output {
      issue: TrackedIssue from "."
    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues" }
    response {
      201 => TrackedIssue
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Comment (idempotent via marker) -----------------------------------

  operation comment {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      id: NonEmptyStr
      body: String
      marker: NonEmptyStr?
    }
    output {
      comment_id: NonEmptyStr from "id"
      ok: Bool from "id != 0"
    }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/comments" }
    response {
      201 => Json
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Set labels (replace full set) ------------------------------------

  operation set_labels {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      id: NonEmptyStr
      labels: List<String>
    }
    output { ok: Bool from "status == 200" }
    transport rest { method: PUT, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/labels" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- Close (idempotent) ------------------------------------------------

  operation close {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      id: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { ok: Bool from "state == \"closed\"" }
    idempotent
    transport rest { method: PATCH, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}" }
    response {
      200 => TrackedIssue
      401 => GitHubErrorShape
      403 => GitHubErrorShape
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      422 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }

  // --- List events -------------------------------------------------------

  operation list_events {
    input {
      auth_token: Secret
      id: NonEmptyStr
      since: String?
    }
    output { events: List<IssueEvent> }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/repos/\{owner\}/\{repo\}/issues/\{id\}/events" }
    response {
      200 => List<IssueEvent>
      404 => GitHubErrorShape
      410 => GitHubErrorShape
      5xx => GitHubErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        {
            number: 42,
            title: "Test issue",

        }

    })

    expect result.ok == true
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/health_check.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/health_check.dag -- SR-4: Health check endpoint.
//
// Cloud Run health check: `/health` returns 200 + worker status
// (idle/processing/draining). Graceful shutdown on SIGTERM
// (finish current stage, release claims).
//
// Acceptance criteria:
//   - Cloud Run readiness probe passes
//   - SIGTERM → clean claim release within 30s

module services.sdlc.providers.health_check

import std.types { NonEmptyStr, EpochMs }

// Worker lifecycle states for the health check response.
type WorkerStatus
  = Idle             // No active work, ready for new claims
  | Processing {     // Currently executing a stage
      issue_id: String
      stage: String
      started_at: EpochMs
    }
  | Draining {       // SIGTERM received, finishing current stage
      issue_id: String
      stage: String
      drain_started_at: EpochMs
    }
  | Unhealthy {      // Worker is in a bad state
      reason: String
    }

// Health check response payload.
type HealthResponse {
  status: String               // "healthy" or "unhealthy"
  worker_id: NonEmptyStr
  worker_status: WorkerStatus
  uptime_seconds: Int
  version: String
  active_claims: Int
  last_heartbeat_at: EpochMs?
}

// Health check configuration.
type HealthConfig {
  port: Int = 8080
  path: String = "/health"
  readiness_path: String = "/ready"
  liveness_path: String = "/alive"
  drain_timeout_seconds: Int = 30
}

// Default health check configuration matching Cloud Run conventions.
data default_health_config: HealthConfig = {
  port: 8080,
  path: "/health",
  readiness_path: "/ready",
  liveness_path: "/alive",
  drain_timeout_seconds: 30
}

// Build the health check response based on current worker state.
fn build_health_response(
  worker_id: NonEmptyStr,
  worker_status: WorkerStatus,
  uptime_seconds: Int,
  version: String,
  active_claims: Int,
  last_heartbeat_at: EpochMs?
) -> HealthResponse {
  let status = match worker_status {
    Idle                   => "healthy"
    Processing { issue_id } => "healthy"
    Draining { issue_id }   => "draining"
    Unhealthy { reason }    => "unhealthy"
  }
  {
    status: status,
    worker_id: worker_id,
    worker_status: worker_status,
    uptime_seconds: uptime_seconds,
    version: version,
    active_claims: active_claims,
    last_heartbeat_at: last_heartbeat_at
  }
}

// Check if the worker should accept new work (readiness probe).
fn is_ready(status: WorkerStatus) -> Bool {
  match status {
    Idle                    => true
    Processing { issue_id } => true
    Draining { issue_id }   => false
    Unhealthy { reason }    => false
  }
}

// Check if the worker is still alive (liveness probe).
fn is_alive(status: WorkerStatus) -> Bool {
  match status {
    Unhealthy { reason } => false
    _                    => true
  }
}

// Check if the drain timeout has been exceeded.
fn drain_timeout_exceeded(
  drain_started_at: EpochMs,
  now: EpochMs,
  timeout_seconds: Int
) -> Bool {
  let elapsed_ms = now - drain_started_at
  let timeout_ms = timeout_seconds * 1000
  elapsed_ms > timeout_ms
}

// Health check HTTP endpoint service.
// Exposes worker status via REST for Cloud Run probes.
service sdlc.HealthCheck {

  config {
    endpoint: "http://0.0.0.0:8080"
  }

  operation health {
    input {}
    output {
      status: String
      worker_id: String
      worker_status: WorkerStatus
      uptime_seconds: Int
    }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/health" }
    response {
      200 => HealthResponse
      503 => HealthResponse
    }
  }

  operation ready {
    input {}
    output { ready: Bool }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/ready" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      503 => Json
    }
  }

  operation alive {
    input {}
    output { alive: Bool }
    readonly
    transport rest { method: GET, path: "/alive" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      503 => Json
    }
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test health_check_idle {

    let response = build_health_response(
      worker_id: "worker-1",
      worker_status: Idle,
      uptime_seconds: 120,
      version: "0.1.0",
      active_claims: 0,
      last_heartbeat_at: None
    )

    expect response.status == "healthy"
    expect is_ready(status: Idle) == true
    expect is_alive(status: Idle) == true
}

test health_check_processing {

    let status = Processing {
      issue_id: "42",
      stage: "design",
      started_at: 1706745600000
    }

    let response = build_health_response(
      worker_id: "worker-1",
      worker_status: status,
      uptime_seconds: 300,
      version: "0.1.0",
      active_claims: 1,
      last_heartbeat_at: 1706745610000
    )

    expect response.status == "healthy"
    expect is_ready(status: status) == true
}

test health_check_draining {

    let status = Draining {
      issue_id: "42",
      stage: "design",
      drain_started_at: 1706745600000
    }

    expect is_ready(status: status) == false
    expect is_alive(status: status) == true
}

test drain_timeout {

    let exceeded = drain_timeout_exceeded(
      drain_started_at: 1706745600000,
      now: 1706745640000,
      timeout_seconds: 30
    )

    expect exceeded == true
}
```

// services/sdlc/providers/inline_artifact_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: InlineArtifactStore implements ArtifactStore.
//
// Stores small artifacts as local JSON files. For local development only;
// cloud_run uses GcsArtifactStore for durable storage.
//
// File layout:
//   {dir}/artifacts/{artifact_id}.json        — artifact content
//   {dir}/markers/{run_key}/{type}/{kind}.json — lifecycle markers
//
// Profile binding: local

module services.sdlc.providers.inline_artifact_store

import interfaces.artifact_store { ArtifactStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, ArtifactPayload, ArtifactType, ArtifactMarker }

// =========================================================================
// InlineArtifactStore : ArtifactStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: local
// Storage: Local JSON files in {dir}/artifacts/ and {dir}/markers/

service file.ArtifactStore : ArtifactStore {

  config {
    dir: String = "target/sdlc/artifacts"
  }

  operation store {
    input { artifact_id: NonEmptyStr, payload: ArtifactPayload, content_hash: NonEmptyStr }
    output { stored: Bool, conflict: Bool }
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/artifacts/\{artifact_id\}.json" }
  }

  operation retrieve {
    input { artifact_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { found: Bool, payload: ArtifactPayload?, content_hash: NonEmptyStr? }
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/artifacts/\{artifact_id\}.json" }
  }

  operation store_marker {
    input { marker: ArtifactMarker }
    output { stored: Bool }
    transport file { op: WRITE, path: "\{dir\}/markers/\{marker.run_key\}/\{marker.artifact_type\}/\{marker.kind\}.json" }
  }

  operation get_canonical_marker {
    input { run_key: NonEmptyStr, artifact_type: ArtifactType }
    output { found: Bool, marker: ArtifactMarker? }
    transport file { op: READ, path: "\{dir\}/markers/\{run_key\}/\{artifact_type\}/Canonical.json" }
  }
}

// -- Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test inline_artifact_store {

    input store/prepare.artifact_id -> "art-001"
    input store/prepare.content_hash -> "sha256:abc123"

    mock store/execute.response -> file_response(0, {
        stored: true,
        conflict: false
    })

    expect result.stored == true
}

test inline_artifact_retrieve {

    input retrieve/prepare.artifact_id -> "art-001"

    mock retrieve/execute.response -> file_response(0, {
        found: true,
        payload: { content: "artifact content" },
        content_hash: "sha256:abc123"
    })

    expect result.found == true
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/llm_agent_provider.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/llm_agent_provider.dag
//
// SP-3: Real LLM agent provider. Wires AgentProvider interface to
// Anthropic/OpenAI APIs via REST transport pipeline.
//
// Unlike CodexAgentProvider (shell transport, CLI subprocess),
// this provider sends prompts directly to LLM APIs and collects
// structured responses. For code generation tasks, the agent
// operates in a multi-turn loop:
//   1. Send task prompt with repo context
//   2. Receive plan/code from LLM
//   3. Apply changes to branch
//   4. Run verification (cargo test, cargo clippy)
//   5. If failures, send error context back to LLM for retry
//
// Profile bindings: cloud_run (real API keys via credential chain)
//
// SC-6: Transport blocks will wire real REST calls to LLM APIs.

module services.sdlc.providers.llm_agent_provider

import interfaces.agent_provider { AgentProvider }
import interfaces.credential_provider { CredentialProvider }
import services.llm.anthropic { llm.Anthropic }
import services.llm.openai { llm.OpenAI }
import services.git { git.Core }
import services.cargo { Cargo }
import std.types {
  NonEmptyStr, AgentStatus, ApprovalMode, CredentialFlow, AccessToken
}

// Map provider string to the correct LLM service call.
fn build_agent_prompt(task_prompt: String, repo_path: String, branch: String) -> String {
  "You are a software engineering agent working on branch '{branch}' in repo at '{repo_path}'.\n\nTask:\n{task_prompt}\n\nInstructions:\n1. Analyze the codebase and understand the task\n2. Implement the changes\n3. Ensure all tests pass (cargo test)\n4. Ensure no clippy warnings (cargo clippy)\n5. Commit your changes with a clear message\n\nRespond with the implementation plan and code changes."
}

fn build_system_prompt() -> String {
  "You are an expert software engineer. You write clean, correct, well-tested Rust code. You follow existing patterns in the codebase. You never introduce clippy warnings or test failures."
}

fn parse_agent_status(stop_reason: String) -> AgentStatus {
  match stop_reason {
    "end_turn"    => Completed
    "max_tokens"  => Running
    "stop"        => Completed
    _             => Failed
  }
}

service LlmAgentProvider : AgentProvider {

  config {
    provider: NonEmptyStr = "anthropic"
    default_model: NonEmptyStr = "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
    max_turns: Int = 5
  }

  // SC-6: spawn wires to LLM API via REST transport.
  // Implementation: create branch -> send prompt to LLM -> parse response.
  operation spawn {
    input {
      prompt: String
      repo_path: String
      branch: NonEmptyStr
      model: String?
      timeout_seconds: Int?
      approval_mode: ApprovalMode?
    }
    output {
      run_id: NonEmptyStr
      status: AgentStatus
      started: Bool
    }
  }

  // SC-6: poll returns terminal state (LLM-based agents are synchronous).
  operation poll {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { status: AgentStatus, finished: Bool, exit_code: Int?, error: String? }
    readonly
  }

  operation cancel {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr, reason: String? }
    output { cancelled: Bool, final_status: AgentStatus }
  }

  // SC-6: get_result uses git diff to find changed files on agent branch.
  operation get_result {
    input { run_id: NonEmptyStr }
    output { status: AgentStatus, exit_code: Int?, stdout: String?, stderr: String?, files_changed: List<String> }
    readonly
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture llm_agent_env {
  mock config.provider -> "anthropic"
  mock config.default_model -> "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"
  mock config.max_turns -> 5
}

test llm_agent_spawn_anthropic : llm_agent_env {

    input spawn.prompt -> "Add a hello world function to lib.rs"
    input spawn.repo_path -> "."
    input spawn.branch -> "sdlc/issue-42"
    input spawn.model -> "claude-sonnet-4-20250514"

    // Mock: git checkout succeeds
    mock checkout/execute.response -> shell_response(0, "Switched to new branch 'sdlc/issue-42'")

    // Mock: Anthropic Messages API response
    mock llm_messages/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
      content: [{ type: "text", text: "## Plan\n\n1. Add hello_world function\n2. Add test\n\n```rust\npub fn hello_world() -> &'static str { \"Hello, world!\" }\n```" }],
      model: "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
      stop_reason: "end_turn",
      usage: { input_tokens: 500, output_tokens: 200 }
    })

    expect result.started == true
    expect result.run_id is NonEmpty
}

test llm_agent_get_result_with_files : llm_agent_env {

    input get_result.run_id -> "sdlc/issue-42-abc123"

    // Mock: git diff returns changed files
    mock diff/execute.response -> shell_response(0, "src/lib.rs\nsrc/tests/lib_test.rs")

    expect result.status == Completed
    expect result.files_changed |> count() >= 1
}

# dsl/services/sdlc/providers/local_credential_provider.dag
```
// services/sdlc/providers/local_credential_provider.dag
//
// SP-4: Local keychain credential provider.
// Token storage for the local development profile.
//
// Stores credentials in an encrypted file under ~/.gunbc/credentials/
// or reads from OS keychain via `security` (macOS) or `secret-tool` (Linux).
//
// Profile binding: local
//
// Strategy:
//   1. Check encrypted credential file (~/.gunbc/credentials/{source_id}.enc)
//   2. If file exists and not expired, decrypt and return
//   3. If missing or expired, fall back to env var lookup
//   4. If env var exists, cache to encrypted file for next time
//   5. If no source found, try OS keychain as last resort
//
// The encrypted file format uses AES-256-GCM with a key derived from
// the machine ID (hermetic local-only, not shared across machines).
//
// SC-6: Transport wired. acquire uses file probe/read for cache, shell.Env for
// env var lookup, file write for cache persistence. validate is pure.
// Transport chain:
//   1. file { op: PROBE } — check cache file exists
//   2. file { op: READ }  — read cached credential JSON
//   3. shell.Env.Get      — env var lookup (GITHUB_TOKEN, etc.)
//   4. file { op: WRITE } — persist to cache for next time

module services.sdlc.providers.local_credential_provider

import std.types {
  AccessToken, AuthScheme, CredentialFlow, NonEmptyStr, FilePath, EpochMs
}
import std.resources { Filesystem }
import interfaces.credential_provider { CredentialProvider }
import services.shell { shell.Env }

// Credential cache entry stored in ~/.gunbc/credentials/
type CachedCredential {
  token: String
  scheme: String
  source_id: String
  cached_at: EpochMs
  expires_at: EpochMs?
}

fn credential_cache_path(source_id: String) -> String {
  "~/.gunbc/credentials/{source_id}.json"
}

fn env_var_for_source(source_id: String) -> String {
  // Convention: source_id "github" -> GITHUB_TOKEN
  //             source_id "anthropic" -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
  match source_id {
    "github"    => "GITHUB_TOKEN"
    "anthropic" => "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
    "openai"    => "OPENAI_API_KEY"
    "codex"     => "CODEX_API_KEY"
    _           => "GUNBC_SECRET_{source_id}"
  }
}

fn is_expired(expires_at: EpochMs?, now: EpochMs) -> Bool {
  match expires_at {
    Some(exp) => exp < now
    None      => false
  }
}

service LocalCredentialProvider : CredentialProvider {
  config {
    cache_dir: FilePath = "~/.gunbc/credentials"
  }

  // acquire wires to file probe + env var lookup + optional keychain.
  // Transport chain: file PROBE -> file READ -> shell.Env.Get -> file WRITE.
  operation acquire {
    input {
      secret_name: NonEmptyStr
      flow: CredentialFlow
      scheme: AuthScheme = Bearer
      source_id: NonEmptyStr
      required_scopes: List<String>
    }
    output {
      token: AccessToken
    }
    idempotent
    readonly
    uses fs: Filesystem(mode: ReadWrite)
  }

  // validate checks token is non-empty. Pure operation — no transport.
  operation validate {
    input { token: AccessToken }
    output { valid: Bool, expires_in: Int? }
    readonly
  }
}

// ── Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

test local_cred_from_env {

    input acquire.secret_name -> "github-token"
    input acquire.flow -> Stored { secret_name: "github-token" }
    input acquire.source_id -> "github"
    input acquire.required_scopes -> []

    // No cached file
    mock probe/execute.response -> file_response_not_found("~/.gunbc/credentials/github.json")

    // Env var exists
    mock env_get/execute.response -> { value: "ghp_mock_token_12345" }

    // Write cache
    mock write/execute.response -> { ok: true }

    expect result.token.token == "ghp_mock_token_12345"
    expect result.token.source_id == "github"
}

test local_cred_from_cache {

    input acquire.secret_name -> "anthropic-key"
    input acquire.flow -> Stored { secret_name: "anthropic-key" }
    input acquire.source_id -> "anthropic"
    input acquire.required_scopes -> []

    // Cached file exists
    mock probe/execute.response -> file_response("~/.gunbc/credentials/anthropic.json")
    mock read/execute.response -> { content: "sk-ant-mock-key-12345" }

    expect result.token.token == "sk-ant-mock-key-12345"
}

test local_cred_validate_nonempty {

    input validate.token -> {
      token: "ghp_valid_token",
      scheme: "Bearer",
      source_id: "github",
      expires_at: null
    }

    expect result.valid == true
}

test local_cred_validate_empty {

    input validate.token -> {
      token: "",
      scheme: "Bearer",
      source_id: "missing",
      expires_at: null
    }

    expect result.valid == false
}
```

// services/sdlc/providers/pubsub_signal_store.dag
//
// Layer 3 concrete implementation: PubSubSignalStore implements SignalStore.
//
// Uses GCP Pub/Sub for durable at-least-once signal delivery.
// Emit publishes to a topic; consume pulls from a subscription;
// ack acknowledges a received message.
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run

module services.sdlc.providers.pubsub_signal_store

import interfaces.signal_store { SignalStore }
import std.types { NonEmptyStr, Signal, SignalType }
import std.errors { GcpErrorShape }

// =========================================================================
// PubSubSignalStore : SignalStore
// =========================================================================
//
// Profile binding: cloud_run
// Transport: GCP Pub/Sub REST API
// Topic: projects/{project_id}/topics/{topic}
// Subscription: projects/{project_id}/subscriptions/{subscription}

service pubsub.SignalStore : SignalStore {

  config {
    topic: NonEmptyStr
    subscription: NonEmptyStr
    project_id: NonEmptyStr
    endpoint: "https://pubsub.googleapis.com"
    auth: BearerToken
    auth_input: access_token
    rate_limit: { requests: 1000, per: minute, scope: pubsub }
    retry: { max_attempts: 3, backoff: exponential, retry_on: [429, 500, 503] }
  }

  operation emit {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      signal: Signal
    }
    output { emitted: Bool }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/v1/projects/\{project_id\}/topics/\{topic\}:publish" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation consume {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      signal_types: List<SignalType>
      limit: Int?
    }
    output { signals: List<Signal> }
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/v1/projects/\{project_id\}/subscriptions/\{subscription\}:pull" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }

  operation ack {
    input {
      access_token: Secret
      idempotency_key: NonEmptyStr
    }
    output { acked: Bool }
    idempotent
    transport rest { method: POST, path: "/v1/projects/\{project_id\}/subscriptions/\{subscription\}:acknowledge" }
    response {
      200 => Json
      400 => GcpErrorShape
      401 => GcpErrorShape
      403 => GcpErrorShape
      429 => GcpErrorShape
      5xx => GcpErrorShape
    }
  }
}

// -- Tests ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

fixture gcs_auth {
    mock cloud_env.config -> { provider: "gcp", runtime: "cloud-run" }
    mock cloud_env.credential -> { token: "<MOCK_GCS_TOKEN>", source_type: "static", scheme: "bearer" }
}

    input emit/prepare.signal -> {
        type: "StageTransition",
        idempotency_key: "sig-001",
        payload: { issue_id: "42", from_stage: "idea", to_stage: "design" },
        created_at: ""
    }

    mock emit/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
        messageIds: ["msg-001"]
    })

    expect result.emitted == true
}

test pubsub_signal_consume : gcs_auth {

    mock consume/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {
        receivedMessages: [{
            ackId: "ack-001",
            message: {
                data: "",
                attributes: {
                    type: "StageTransition",
                    idempotency_key: "sig-001"
                }
            }
        }]
    })

    expect result.signals is NonEmpty
}

test pubsub_signal_ack : gcs_auth {

    input ack/prepare.idempotency_key -> "sig-001"

    mock ack/execute.response -> rest_response(200, {})

    expect result.acked == true
}
